title: Asahina Mafuyu — Card Story

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Really? Thanks.
I've been really into baking recently.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Wait, you made these yourself?
Your homemaker talent must be off the charts!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Well, you're pretty good with needlework yourself, right?
I know you make things like pouches.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: I'm just doing it as a hobby, actually.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Well, I still think that's amazing.
It must be nice to have hobbies...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Huh? You don't have hobbies, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hm, if I had to say something... My hobby is keeping a fish tank, I guess?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Wow, you have a fish tank?
I think that's a great hobby!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Yeah, it really suits you!
What sort of fish do you keep?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Actually, I don't have any fish at all.
I was quite pleased with it after just putting sand and waterweeds inside.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Haha, that's one way of doing it.
I guess keeping live fish can be quite tedious too, huh?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Like when you have to clean the tank...

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: The tank alone would work as decoration, so why not?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, the bell should be ringing any time now. Let's go back.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Don't worry about it.
But try not to run around so much, alright?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Who was that just now?
Is it just me or was she trembling at Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Was she? She looked like a first year.
Maybe she was just flustered because she ran into an upperclassman.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hehe, you may be right.
Anyway, let's go.

rows.Speaker: Mom
rows.Line:
Oh, Mafuyu, I was just about to go shopping.
Would you like to come along with me?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Ah, I'm so sorry.
I have homework and class prep to do, and I'll need to study, so...

rows.Speaker: Mom
rows.Line: You're so hard-working, Mafuyu. Well then, let me prepare some delicious tea for you before I head out!

rows.Speaker: Mom
rows.Line: Come downstairs once you've settled down a little, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Having a fish tank suits me, huh...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Why does it suit me, though?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
There's nothing swimming inside...
Of course there isn't. I didn't put any fish in.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It looks so lonely and comfortable inside.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But it's only big enough for an arm...

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Mafuyu, what tea would you like to have today?
Ceylon? Earl Grey?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, I can't decide!
I'm coming down now, give me a minute!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'll just pick whichever one is on the right.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Thanks for waiting! I'll go with Earl Grey today...
Oh, there's a snack too!

rows.Speaker: English Teacher
rows.Line: Please start reading from page 32 of the textbook.

rows.Speaker: English Teacher
rows.Line:
Good, thank you.
Ms. Asahina, you're next.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Whoa, Mafuyu's a natural at this. She's amazing.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Her pronunciation's so good. I don't understand what she just read...

rows.Speaker: English Teacher
rows.Line: Good, thank you. Your pronunciation was impeccable. You'll have no problems overseas.

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line:
<I've finished the lyrics for the new song.
I'll send them to everyone now.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <Got it. Ah! There are English phrases this time.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Let's see... This third word is arrow, right?>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line:
<Oh, but you're pronouncing it with the R sound.
It should be with the L sound, or the meaning changes completely.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line:
<R makes it arrow, as in bow and arrow.
L makes it allow.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <Oh... In that case, what's the correct way to pronounce this word?>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <For the R sound, roll your tongue backwards without touching anything. For the L sound, let the tip of the tongue touch your upper front teeth.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Okay... So if I have to pronounce it with the L sound... Allow. Did I get that right?>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Hmph. English is no sweat once you get the hang of it.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <Nah, just knowing how to pronounce the L and R sounds won't get you anywhere, at least not overseas.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<I know that...
Sigh, why can't everyone just speak Japanese?>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Hehe. Oh, but some things in English can be understood if you speak in Japanese too, you know?>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <For example... Ah. You could use ani, iju to pronounce the English phrase, I need you.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Whoa! It really does sound like that.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line:
<Haha! Hey, that's super interesting!
Do you have any other examples?>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Maybe... Aha! How about haba, naissu ne for have a nice day?>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <You're right! I can totally understand that!>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <You're really good with stuff like this, Yuki.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line:
<Not really.
I was just repeating what I learned in my English cram classes.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Oh, but it may be pretty funny to create a song with English lyrics that sound like actual Japanese words.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line:
<Haha! Yeah, that'll definitely be hilarious!
But it'll also be really difficult to pull off.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <So we'll write Japanese lyrics and turn them into English? Wait. Or is it the other way around?>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Oh boy. Just thinking about it gives me a headache.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Hehe. It's difficult to learn, I'll admit.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <But when you use words you don't usually use, it makes you feel like you can become someone different for a change, don't you think?>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<Become someone different, huh?
Hm... What does that feel like?>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line:
<Oh, well...
I can't think of a good way to describe it.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Becoming someone different is...maybe something like taking a photo of someone else instead of a selfie?>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <Or maybe before and after putting on makeup?>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Hehe, yes. I guess that was what I had in mind too.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: (What it feels like to become someone else...)

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: (Why did I even say something like that?)

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Yuki, can you sing these song lyrics out loud for us?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I'd like you to take a psychological test.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <You know that I have someone coming over to do housework for me, right?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I told her that I have a friend who doesn't understand herself, and asked what she thinks might help.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <And she told you I should take a psychological test?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<I took one too. It was quite fun.
Do you want to try it?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Thanks. I'll read it out to you.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <“Imagine you're walking on a beach, alone. The weather is pleasant and the sound of the gentle waves is very soothing.”>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I was wondering about that too, but apparently it doesn't matter.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <What's important is that you answer the questions honestly. It's all imaginary, so there's no need to focus on the details.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <“You keep walking until you arrive at a small harbor. A single boat is moored there.”>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<“Question one: What size is the boat?
Would it be easy or difficult to get on it?”>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<It's very big and impressive.
You'd need a special invitation to get on it.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<You took this test too?
What was your answer?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <A shabby little boat you can just hop on, but it's full of holes and leaks. So better not to risk it.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But let's move on to the next question.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<“Question two: You get on the boat.
There is an animal on it. What animal is it?”>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Dragon? So you went for a fantastical creature.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <The size of the boat apparently corresponds to personal ambitions.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Then, how easy it is to get on the boat depends on your personality. If it's easy, you're an open, straightforward person.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <If it's difficult, that means you're an introvert, and you rarely seek help from others.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Your boat was so big you'd need an invitation to get on...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <In other words, I have a difficult personality.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <That part tells you about how satisfied you are with your daily life.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <If it's a dog, cat, or some other pet, it means you're generally happy.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <If it's a rat or other small creature like that, you're slightly dissatisfied. A cow, horse or other farm animal means you're only pretending to be satisfied.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <A large, dangerous animal like a lion means you're very unhappy and at the end of your tether...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Your shark and my dragon would fall into that category.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <If you feel like you can't take it anymore, it's okay for you to come to us for help.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Actually, you absolutely must come to us.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's what, the third time we're meeting here?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
It's becoming our regular haunt!
I'm glad I suggested it♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: At first, I thought it was really unnecessary to have a hangout at the diner just because we released a song.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Isn't that hard on you, Kanade?
You don't really like going out, right?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I wouldn't like to meet up in person all the time, but if it's only every now and then...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Phew, I was worried you hated it!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sweet! Let's start our celebratory party when the food gets here! You need to eat something proper, Kanade, you can't live off instant noodles!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: My housekeeper cooked dinner for me yesterday. I eat normal food too.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Your HOUSEKEEPER?! You hired a housekeeper?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yeah. It frees up time for me to work on music, and I get healthy homemade meals cooked for me. She cooks for me twice a week and cleans.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha, making music really is your life, huh.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I think your housekeeper may be a girl from my school.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What? Ms. Mochizuki's from the same school as you? How did you know?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: A girl from my club that I talk to often told me her friend works as domestic help.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wait, what? You talk to people at school?
What's she like?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't know how to describe her... Her name's Shizuku Hinomori, and she's a famous idol, but I don't really know about the things she does outside school.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hold on a sec!
Shizuku Hinomori who used to be the front girl of Cheerful * Days?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh yeah, she quit that group, no?
I had no idea she was in the same school as Mafuyu. Nice!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: She's really beautiful, isn't she? Unlike Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Excuse me? She may have a more memorable face, but my overall silhouette is—

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ena's always pushing her little bust up for photos, trying to make it look bigger.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Where's this coming from? I don't do that!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, wow...
So this is what Mafuyu's like when she's angry...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I didn't say that in anger.
But...maybe I was angry?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You might have helped me make a new discovery. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So we were talking about why you think my housekeeper's from your school?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes. It's an unusual occupation for a high school student, so I immediately thought it might be her.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: My classmate An formed a group with two boys from our school and a girl from Miyamasuzaka. They sing together.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And I swear she mentioned one of the members is called Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Could it be your younger brother, Ena?
Didn't he tell you about it?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Nah. We don't talk about stuff like that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What, you don't even care to know about your brother's hobbies? Poor Akito has such an unsympathetic sister.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm just not interested in his music.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The world's so small, isn't it?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We met online but it turned out we all live in the same city, and here we are gathered around a table, having a meal at a local diner.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Is that something you're happy about or not?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I think it's great to be able to meet up and have a meal together!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You always order fries when we come here.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Because I looove fries♪
You're welcome to them, too! I'll eat them when they're not so hot.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You're still so sensitive to hot food, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thanks for sharing, but better hurry up and have some before they're all gone.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Nooo! When you say that, I can't tell if you're joking!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Today? Let's see... I was asked to answer a rather difficult question in math class.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: And you solved it anyway, correct?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes. I prepared properly for the class, after all.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe, yes, you prepare for your classes every day.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You've always been telling me to prepare for class, and that really came in handy today, so thank you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I believe there's going to be a math quiz next week...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: One of my classmates asked me to teach her, so I did just that during lunch.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Oh, you help your friends out with their studies too?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Ah, it was just for a little while...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. It's nice to know people look up to you in school.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's no big deal. I'm not doing anything amazing at all.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Don't say that.
You're our pride and joy, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Even though these words that dad and mom wanted to hear are coming out of my mouth on their own?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Nightcord notification... At this hour, it must be because either K or Amia just logged in.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Even in this group, I play the goody two-shoes role. Even though I'm no goody two-shoes...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But... If I'm not that, then what am I?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I understand this isn't who I really am, but if someone asked me to describe my true self, I wouldn't know what to say.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
What's this?
I don't remember saving this image...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Looks like a music file.
Who sent it to me?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Huh?! Why did the screen just flash?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Do you know something about me?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No. I don't know about you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You'll have to look for your true feelings yourself if you want to find them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So please look for your true feelings.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm here to help you with that.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (If I can find my true feelings, will I be able to find my true self as well?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Welcome home, Mafuyu.
Help yourself to the really delicious jelly in the fridge.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Can I really? That's great!
Thank you, mom.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I'm hoping to finish preparing for tomorrow's classes first, so I'll have the jelly after dinner, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hm... The same old goody two-shoes persona...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Maybe I'll check the computer first before I start preparing for tomorrow's classes...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Yes. But I have to prepare for tomorrow's classes first.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <So I may only start work quite a bit later.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Doesn't matter. I have to do my prep.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I still can't stop being Ms. Goody Two Shoes.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I told mom I wanted to prepare for classes, and...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Even though it was just an excuse to placate her, here I am, trying to studiously carry it out anyway...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <So does that mean if I stop preparing for classes, I'll stop being goody two-shoes?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I've been feeling quite strange lately too.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I'm becoming less and less uncomfortable with the idea of being goody two-shoes.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Is it because I got to talk with everyone in SEKAI?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <If I can keep changing myself like this...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Will I one day be able to show my imperfect self not just to the group, but in school and at home too?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<But can you really call that growth?
Am I not just adapting myself? Or maybe regressing?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <And I don't even know what to think or feel about my inability to form an opinion about myself.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Am I only thinking this way because I haven't actually found my true self yet?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes. Unlike Enanan and Amia, you're usually very quiet even when I'm not muted.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I must be disturbing you then. I'm sorry.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Was that an apology from the heart?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I thought so. And neither was that one just now, right?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I don't know what other people think of the changes you're going through, but...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <If you're feeling less uncomfortable about yourself, it means that you're definitely changing.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <As for whether that's a good or bad thing, I guess we'll find out in the days ahead.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<I'm done with class prep.
I should be able to get a bit of work in before dinner.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<What do you think?
If you have nothing urgent for me to handle, I'll continue where I left off yesterday...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <It's good... The part Yuki arranged was very well done.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I agree♪
Feels like that part made K's composition even more appealing than usual?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Well, it's pretty much Yuki's usual stuff, though?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Which means you think she's usually fantastic, right?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hey, I said nothing of that sort. Having to go along with her was why we posted this new song late in the first place, so that was the least she could do for us.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, Enanan, tough outside but soft inside, she is♪>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Since there are no issues, I'll be logging off soon.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <What? Already? It's earlier than you usually do, though.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I have a committee meeting before morning assembly tomorrow.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Okay. You should definitely turn in early today, then.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I have to get ready for bed...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (It just draws me in for some reason.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (There's nothing inside except aquatic plants and sand...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (It's just like me. An empty vessel with nothing inside...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(Or, at least, that's what I've always thought.
Until...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: How do you know that song?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I've known this song from the beginning.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I have been singing this song since this SEKAI was first created.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Miku in the SEKAI born from my feelings knew this song from the start. Which means...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (So, I'm not...am empty vessel after all? Besides...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yuki, you said before that you can't feel or understand happiness and joy, but I have a different opinion.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I think, you've probably just convinced yourself that you can't.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <How else would you be able to write lyrics like these?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (If Kanade is right, then I should be able to feel as well.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But then, why can I still not feel anything now?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Why am I...thinking of that doll again?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (It makes me feel sick, pain, and agony.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(I don't need this.
If that's what feelings are like, then I should just do away with all of them—)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Mafuyu, you're really pale! What happened?
You're not feeling well?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (She came running over almost immediately back then...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (It's similar to the sensations I feel when I meet with Miku in SEKAI and chat with her...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(This doesn't feel painful or agonizing.
I should keep this feeling with me.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (The way I kept Kanade's song that Miku sang...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Oh boy, I can't focus anymore.
I've more or less finished this section anyway, so I'll be logging off now.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<I'm logging off too.
I really need to catch up on all that lost sleep.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, I'll do that after I find a good place to stop—>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Hey. Why do you think feelings and emotions exist?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hey, don't go all quiet on us right after dropping a bomb like that just before we were about to log off!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <It's really unusual for you to try to start a conversation. Did something happen to make you ask that?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
