rows.Line: We were also wondering if we should get another plate of fries. What do you think?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, well, I wasn't asking you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Alright, that settles that♪
Excuse me! Can we get another order of fries?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Finished. They gave us less homework than usual today...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
It's not even 25:00 yet but...
I think I'll log in early and get started.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Hello. Is it just you right now, Amia?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <K was on just a second ago but left to make some instant noodles after her tummy gave this really big growl.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Enanan's probably still in class, so I'm guessing she won't be on for a while.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I'm going to start working so I'll be muting myself now.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Oh, Yuki, wait.
Can we talk for a bit?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <There's something important I want to talk to you about...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Shouldn't we wait until everyone else gets here...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Uh, well...
I want to talk to you about this actually.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<How do I even ask this...?
Hang on...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I don't mind waiting, but K and Enanan might get here while I do...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Haha. Things could get a little awkward if that happens.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So... Are you scared about moving forward, Yuki?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Lemme put it this way. Are you scared of things changing to the point where some really big questions start being answered?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I still don't know what you're trying to ask, Amia. Please, try to be clearer...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <What I meant by “moving forward” is, in your case, Yuki, learning to feel again.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And that's something you have to do if you want to discover who the “real you” is, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But remember that also might mean putting yourself in some really tough situations, like that time we went to the Doll Exhibit, remember?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I was asking if you're afraid of that at all...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<I want to avoid that pain...
But I feel like things have improved since then.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <When I first met all of you in SEKAI.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Back then, it didn't matter how many songs I wrote. The pain wouldn't go away and I felt like disappearing was the only way out.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <What I felt when we went to the Doll Exhibit was awful too, but I felt much better after writing lyrics about that...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<K promised me.
She said that she would keep composing until she can save me.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <If it means making that song a reality, I won't shy away from moving forward.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Right... Yeah, I get it.
This is something you have to do.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Hey, everyone! I made it!
25:00 right on the dot!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Hey, Enanan!
Did you pass out on your bed after coming home from school?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <No, I was taking a nice, relaxing bath and lost track of the time.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I don't think this is the right time to ask... Oh well...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, Yuki and Enanan are here now.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Okay, since it's 25:00, shall we get started?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But I don't have cram school today and my homework assignments didn't seem too bad, so I should be able to start working right when I get home...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, Hoshino, are you also about to head out?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. I just happened to see you walking by...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hehe. So you came over to greet me.
Shall we head out together?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me.
About that class representative business we were working on just now...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm sorry about the first years running behind schedule and having to ask you for help. Right as you were heading to the archery club no less...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You don't have to apologize. I'm a class representative just like you, so I felt compelled to see this through to the end.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Also, last year, I witnessed some seniors going out of their way to help others, so I thought I should do the same starting this year...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(She's such an incredible person.
She's smart, a great athlete, and unbelievably kind on top of all that...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, Hoshino, are you okay in terms of time? I remember you mentioning that you have band practice today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Y-Yes, but I already let my friends know that I may not be able to make it today.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: By the way... Have you always been interested in music and being in a band?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Well, my parents both like music quite a bit, and my father owns some instruments, including guitars, so I was exposed to it at an early age.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I really became interested in music because of Hatsune Miku.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes! A Miku song can differ so much in terms of style and genre just based on who produced it!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A song can be very cute, it can sound really cool or even a little scary.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. I know what you mean.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: At first, I was in awe over just how amazing Miku is...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But when I was in junior high school, a lot had happened and I had a hard time dealing with it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I didn't know what I wanted to do with myself or what I should do moving forward...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But Miku songs helped me get through that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The producers of these songs are all trying to convey some sort of message or what they feel through Miku's voice...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I started wanting to become just like her in order to tell my childhood friends what I was feeling...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Telling them how you feel like how Miku does... Were you able to do that in the end?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes!
It wasn't easy, but I somehow managed...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'm glad you did.
So you're a step closer to being just like Miku, your hero.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's just... So much goes through my mind whenever I'm trying to write lyrics for my band's songs...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But it seems like I just wanted to be open and honest about how I feel...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Instead of feeling embarrassed about how I feel or talking about it in a roundabout way, I should be more direct...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I mean, I have a better idea of what I want to do, but still don't really know exactly how I feel or what the right answer is...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honestly, I have only Miku to thank for being able to get this far.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Without her, I wouldn't be in a band or even the person you're talking to right now...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Also, I apologize for going on so much about Miku...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, I had fun listening to what you had to say.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So... Would you mind if I asked you one last question?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What does Miku mean to you, Hoshino?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
What does she mean to me?
Well...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
She's someone that can become anything.
Almost like freedom itself...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She's my band's role model and my savior!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Thank you, Hoshino.
Please, get home safe.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you! If you'll excuse me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: A role model and a savior, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Conversely, what does Miku mean to me...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Mafuyu...
You're earlier than usual today.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hm? Is something bothering you again...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She's my band's role model and my savior!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Mafuyu...
Would you like to sit here?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Can I stay here and think for a bit...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (This feeling keeps lingering within me, but I'm not really sure what it is...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I'm just grasping at straws at this point...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I want you to feel what I did. I want you to smile the way I did back then.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (If I can just put what I'm feeling into words... Like that time Kanade helped me remember...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: This may sound like a lot...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But would you mind singing the songs I made with Kanade in order?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Were you able the think of anything...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That did help me think, but I wasn't able to find an answer...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (While writing lyrics, it's easy to find what needs to be fixed when Miku sings them.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Mafuyu...?
Would you like me to sing again?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: This time, I'd like to just listen.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay. I'm here to sing just for you, Mafuyu. I'll be happy as long as I'm able to do that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Hey, Yuki!
We were just talking about you and K♪>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, about what happened two years ago.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <There were some things that we learned for the first time, so we were just saying how nice it was to hear that story.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<*Sigh*
And as usual, you don't really care...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Hey, cut her some slack.
She literally just got here.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But while we're at it, are there any other really interesting things about you two that we still don't know about?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Huh? Um...
Not off the top of my head...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <It'd be something more recent as opposed to two years ago...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <K and I took a psychological test this one time.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Wait, you two took a psychological test together?!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I think it was around the time we'd just started going over to SEKAI and I asked the housekeeper who's been coming over to my place about Yuki.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <She suggested that a psychological test could help determine what a person's conscious and subconscious selves are actually like.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I had no idea! K, do you have the results of that test saved somewhere?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Awesome! Since you two took it, we should totally take it too♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, I'd be lying if I said that I'm not interested.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <By the way, how much did it get right?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Oh, here it is...
I'll start reading each question.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Imagine you're walking on a beach, alone. The weather is pleasant and the sound of the gentle waves is very soothing.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <You keep walking until you arrive at a small harbor. A single boat is moored there.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Question one: What size is the boat?
Would it be easy or difficult to get on it?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Maybe... A yacht or sailboat? Yeah, let's go with a sailboat that I'm eagerly about to board!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hmm... I'd say it's a big cruise liner. One that you can board by invitation only!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Yes. I said that it's a big ship that only invited guests could board, so I'd have trouble joining them.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Whoa, that's pretty much the same answer...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Something small and run down.
I'd avoid boarding it since there's a hole in the hull.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I-Interesting...
I'm curious as to what that tells us about you.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <There's still another question, so let's do that before we look at the analysis section.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Question two: You get on the boat.
There is an animal on it. What animal is it?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Animal...? Oh, I'd want them to either be a hedgehog or chinchilla. They're so tiny and cute!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Is that so? Don't you mean you want to take pics of them to post online?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Wh-What are you talking about?!
Anyway, Amia, you're next.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Alright, alright. I'd say... A flamingo!
They're adorably pink and we could travel together!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, I guess that suits you pretty well, Amia. What did you two say, K, Yuki?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <What?! Why'd you two pick something scary?!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Anyway, what does this say about us?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <The first question has to do with one's ambitions. The bigger the ship, the greater one's ambitions supposedly are...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Also, saying that this ship would be easy to board means that you have a very open mind.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <You prefer to close yourself off and brood on your own.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hmm... So it's pretty much right about not having friends, but not so much about brooding or whatever since she likes to lash out...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Just who exactly are you talking about?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Um... The second question had to do with how satisfied you are in terms of your day-to-day life.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Choosing something that more or less counts as a pet means you're essentially happy, but small animals mean the opposite...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Anything along the lines of livestock means one appears to be happy but feels some sort of doubt deep down. Anything big or scary means this person's a ticking timebomb of stress.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I mean... Hedgehogs and chinchillas count as pets, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah. Most people would say dogs or cats when it comes to pets, you know?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But where do flamingos fit into all this?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Don't animals at a zoo more or less count as livestock?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <What?! No way! Why can't they be pets?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, based on that logic, you'd have to lop lions in with cattle.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And forget what I said. K and Yuki picked monsters by comparison!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I mean, a shark and a dragon?
And what it said about being ticking timebombs...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <We took this quite a long time ago. I can't say that I'm feeling that much stress now...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Haha...
To be fair, they might give different responses if they took this now.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, you're right. Shall we get started?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Okay, but that was actually a pretty fun test! Anyway, I'm putting myself on mute now.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I probably would pick something other than a dragon, but what...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
That can wait...
For now, I need to work.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<I hardly ever see you at this time.
Don't you usually still have cram school during days off?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<I already went.
They didn't give us many assignments either, so I was able to finish everything early.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I see. Then, can we talk about your lyrics? I have some questions...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, sorry... That must be my grandma. I'll be right back.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Yes, I'm okay too. I feel fine.
Yes, I've been having plenty to eat.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Huh? Have I been getting sick? No, not even a cold.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Yes. I'm okay, really...
Please be mindful of your own health too. Anyway, I need to go.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Sorry about that, Yuki...
Anyway, where were we?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<I don't mind...
But you forgot to mute yourself, K.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Huh? Oh, again, I'm sorry...
But to be fair, she usually calls to see how I'm doing.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <It's okay, K. You don't need to apologize.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <She must care about you very much...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I live alone and collapsed once already...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Fortunately, she seems much more at ease now that I have a housekeeper coming over to check up on me...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <She's been feeling much better lately, so she hasn't had to stay at the hospital as much as before...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But I have a feeling that trying to take care of me would be too much for her.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I hate to say it, but I wouldn't be able to focus on composing if that were to happen.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Which is why I plan on living alone for the foreseeable future. She even agreed to it after discussing this matter with her.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (She has Ms. Mochizuki to look after her now, so she'll at the very least eat right...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Still, K, I think you should make better use of your room.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <You have sheet music strewn across the floor and your desk, as well as all the notes you crumpled up and tossed. I also remember seeing a box of instant noodles just lying around.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, um... That's actually there because it's in a convenient spot for me...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Isn't that a sign of being a hoarder...?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Also, you should open your window from time to time since air purifiers are only capable of so much.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Thank you for showing so much concern for me, Yuki.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (This counts as being concerned about someone...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Hey... Yuki, you there?
Hello? Anybody home?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Ugh...
I was asking if you could take a look at the rough sketches I just sent over.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<You feeling all right, Yuki?
It's not like you to space out like that.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Hmm... Are you hungry at all?
K just left to grab a quick bite.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I knew it. You missed all of that too...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Did something happen...?
Maybe we can help if something's bothering you...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Interesting. You showed genuine concern for K...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Does that really count as being concerned...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Not really sure, but I say it does.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <This is just my guess, Yuki, but you want K to stay healthy, right...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, she's probably fine now, but a part of me is still worried considering how she had to go to the hospital once already.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I get what you mean since K sort of reinforced that composing still takes top priority based on that story.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Even if this song isn't able to save you, I'll keep composing until I find the one that does.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll keep composing...until you can find yourself.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Do I want her to stay healthy because I want her to fulfill that promise...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<I have a better understanding now.
Thank you, Amia, Enanan.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Anyway, can you look at my sketches now? You're the only one who hasn't yet, Yuki.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Sorry, I'm back.
We're running a little late, but shall we get started?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Can I ask you something before we do, K?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(The lyrics are essentially done...
I can fine-tune each part later and...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<It's almost your birthday, right?
We should throw a party with Miku and the others!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<My birthday...
Sure, do whatever you like.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Whatever WE like?
It's your birthday for crying out loud. Isn't there anything you want...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Haha! Not everyone's as greedy as you, Enanan...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Well, jokes aside...
You don't seem that against us throwing a party for you, Yuki.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I suppose you're right. Again, do whatever you like...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Quit saying that!
I'm sure you know full well that your birthday only comes around once a year.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <At this point, Amia, you sound way more interested in celebrating it than she actually is...>

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Today's your birthday, isn't it?
I'm sure everybody at school will be there to celebrate alongside you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hehe. You think so?
That would be nice.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Yes, it would. However, be sure to turn away any snacks or sweets and such that appear to be homemade. You know, for your own health?

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: That includes video games and other things that may interfere with your studies.

rows.Speaker: Junior Archery Club Member B
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Asahina!
It's not much, but here...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, this wrapping paper's so cute.
Is this from a famous sweets shop...?

rows.Speaker: Junior Archery Club Member B
rows.Line:
Yes, they're macarons!
I could only get you the smallest box, but they're supposed to be really good!

rows.Speaker: Junior Archery Club Member A
rows.Line: I got you some chocolates from this great-looking shop, Asahina! Please try some when you feel you need some sugar while you're studying!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I was told to turn away anything I don't need, but I suppose these are fine since they're store-bought...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you both very much. I'll be sure to try them later.

rows.Speaker: Junior Archery Club Members
rows.Line: Asahina! These are also for you!

rows.Speaker: Junior Archery Club Members
rows.Line: Please, take these too! Thank you for being such a great teacher!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you all very much.
I'm not going anywhere, so let's just go one at a time, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (So many gifts even from just them...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: This is wonderful. I was just thinking about heading over to the archery range.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
It's your birthday today, yes?
Congratulations. These are for you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
A handkerchief?
Oh, there's a cute snowman embroidered in!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Your name means “winter”, so I thought a snowman would be a nice representation of that.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Huh? Does that mean you made this, Hinomori?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Well, just the embroidered part.
I hope you get a chance to use it, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (It's otherwise a fairly simple handkerchief that shouldn't stand out. I might be able to use it day to day.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What do I do...? Are you sure I won't be a bother...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm sure the first-year archery club members will also be handing her their presents.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
But... I made these myself...
It doesn't seem very her, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Good morning, Hoshino, Mochizuki.
What brings you to the second-year classrooms?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Good morning.
Ichika, now's your chance.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I... I heard that it's your birthday today and baked these with Honami's help! Th-They're cookies!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Yes, it would. However, be sure to turn away any snacks or sweets and such that appear to be homemade. You know, for your own health?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um... Honami's an incredible baker and cook, so I'm sure they turned out okay!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. We even made them look like Miku, so they're both delicious and adorable.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, Ichika here like Miku very much...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And we heard that you also like listening to Miku songs, so we arrived on these...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I may've focused a little too much on her face and pigtails, so the rest of her may not look quite right...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (That reminds me of what she said about Miku meaning a lot to her...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I really became interested in music because of Hatsune Miku.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Without her, I wouldn't be in a band or even the person you're talking to right now...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm sorry... Is it not to your liking?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
No, that's not true at all!
This just reminded me of what you said about Miku.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Thank you for the cookies.
Having to eat something so cute is a bit of a shame, but I'll be sure to try them.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Welcome, Mafuyu.
Today's your birthday, isn't it?
Happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Still, what are you all doing here...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I finished making adjustments to that song, so I asked everyone to come here to listen to it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What brings you here, Mafuyu? It's still the middle of the day.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I need to put these away somewhere while I'm still on break. Would you all like to try some...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh wow... These cookies look just like you, Miku. Did someone give you these for your birthday?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, they're from Hoshino, but I can't take them home because she made them herself and my mom said to refuse any gifts like this.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I see...
But she made these for you, right?
Are you sure about us having them?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I wouldn't know how they taste...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I want to have a better understanding.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Not bad...
They do look a lot like Miku.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. At the same time, they have that nice homemade feel since the size of her eyes and the length of her hair differs for each.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hmm... They're so well made that I'm not really sure where to take my first bite...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: To be fair, that may be the easiest place to start.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's good to hear.
However, you are sort of eating yourself...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
It's good. Nice and crispy.
Also...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: They all have this gentle smile on their faces too. Hoshino may've baked them this way in the hopes that you'd do the same, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. Mizuki was talking in the chat about finishing things early tonight so that we'd have time to celebrate your birthday.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, I'll take a look later.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you. We'll make sure to throw you a real party then...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Good, I still have some time until break ends... I should get back to class and have some lunch while I can.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Otori...?
What are you doing hiding in a place like this?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I... Um...
I heard that today's your birthday and...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Th-This person who I perform in shows with told me a little joke that's guaranteed supposed to make anyone who hears it smile!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
<Excuse me! I'd like a hamburger!>
<Of course! Will you be having that here or to go?>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: <Understood! Please fasten your seatbelt and prepare to launch! Wait, aren't you supposed to say, “Take out”...?!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. Being able to play two characters at once is quite a talent I must say.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry, Tsukasa!
I couldn't get your surefire joke to fly!!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Yes, it did sort of crash after takeoff...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I-I'll keep working on it! I vow to make you smile and laugh next year!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I still can't tell what's going through her head.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Also, I should head back to class.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Asahina.
It's so nice that we've been getting more chances to chat lately. I'd love to hear more about your hobbies sometime.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Asahina.
I always really appreciate it whenever you help me with class rep business. I can't thank you enough.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You were also the reason I was able to meet Yoisaki, so I'd like it if we could go out for some food again sometime.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Asahina.
I'd love to hear more about the music you make with Ms. Yoisaki the next time we get a chance to talk!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hmm... Where did I go wrong?
Was it the “Takeoff” part? But I'm sure I said it with a straight face like Tsukasa told me.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Anyway, I promise to make you smile and laugh next time, so please wait until then! If you'll excuse me!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Mafuyu. It's kinda hard to describe, but you've become a little bit more personable compared to before... Just a little bit, and I'm hoping this continues...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That was a great birthday party, wasn't it, Mafuyu? I'm glad you were able to join, and it was fun because you were there!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's also been really nice to see you change little by little for the better. You can always ask me for help, so don't push yourself too hard, alright♪

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Again, Mafuyu, happy birthday.
I've been feeling this from time to time lately, but it seems like you're helping me change as well.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I promise to compose a song that can save you, so please, I hope you'll wait for just a little bit longer.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you for celebrating my birthday...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I still don't really know what's so fun about celebrating with others, Mizuki and everyone else included.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I mean, I don't know how I'm supposed to feel about all this...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I'll remember that you were here to celebrate.

rows.Speaker: Ena's Message
rows.Line: <I really appreciate the concern you've all shown for me, but like I said in SEKAI, I'm gonna keep trying.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Message
rows.Line: <Yeah, you've got this. We believe in you, Ena!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Message
rows.Line: <Tomorrow probably won't be easy for you, so please, try to get some rest.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Are you going to keep working, K?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Yes, I'll stay.
The demo for the next song is almost done.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Alright...
If you're staying, K, I'll keep doing what I can on my end too.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <When do you think she'll finish her illustration...?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But we shouldn't release this song without a music video.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Because having a music video makes it more accessible...?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes. As we discussed before, how our songs are interpreted by others can vary wildly based on whether or not we release them with music videos.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Right now, N25's music absolutely needs both Enanan's art and Amia's videos.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Not only that...
They've helped me quite a lot already.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <There are still times when I'm not sure if the songs I compose include 100% of what I'm trying to express or convey...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Yes. It happens often with demos.
I usually end up asking myself, “This doesn't seem right. What am I missing?”>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <That's usually when I take a look at Yuki's lyrics, your storyboards, Amia, or Enanan's art.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <When I do, that's when a lightbulb goes off in my head, and end up saying, “Oh, that's it...”>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Yes, that's right.
Does that ever happen to you, Yuki?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Now that you mention it, you made some changes at the last minute for our most recent song.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I did. I made those changes after seeing the illustration for that song.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <But Enanan said, “Why'd you change that part? I actually kinda liked it.”>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, seeing Enanan go on her tirade after that was pretty funny.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<She must've felt so conflicted.
She drew that illustration based on lyrics that she liked, but those lyrics ended up changing because of her.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I know, right? At the same time, those changes were for the better, so I heard some joy mixed in with her anger.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Enanan was so hard to deal with that day.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Haha! I definitely don't recommend saying that to her face, Yuki.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I won't. I know it'll just make things worse.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Still, this is why I think Enanan has more of an effect on us than she realizes...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Our videos usually go up late because Enanan takes so much time with her illustrations.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <To her credit, Enanan's usually late because she always says, “I can still do a little better.”>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, it's never because she's out slacking off or doing something else...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <She just keeps trying and trying to make it as good as possible.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Exactly. People like us have the option of thinking, “That's good,” or, “That'll do.”>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Chiefly because there's no real “right answer” in terms of what we do.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<No one knows the right answer.
You just have to keep going until you're satisfied.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But just waiting around doesn't feel right...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I disagree. Don't you think we owe Enanan at least that...?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <No matter what happens, she always finds a way to create something that works for us in the end.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Is it? I was just talking about what's happened in the past.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Anyway, I'm gonna keep looking for materials that match Yuki's lyrics♪>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I'll keep working on the demo I had us all hear in SEKAI.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<I'll go back to working too.
Talk to you later.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, it's time...
I should log in soon.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Hey, Yuki.
I just posted my rough draft to chat. Mind taking a look at it?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<For our song's illustration.
It's finally done.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <We were just about to look at it too.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, me too. It's way easier to tell what you're trying to say compared to before!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (In terms of composition, both sketches are very similar, but this one just feels better overall.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (It was a mess before, but her use of space for the subject and other objects seems much more correct now too...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <That includes you too, Yuki. Don't pull any punches, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <It feels better over all, but you went overboard when it came to working in these motifs to represent the lyrics.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Grr... I was really careful about that too...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<But I felt the same thing.
Maybe I should cut back on those a little.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<No, wait.
I actually kind of like it the way it is.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I agree that it's a bit all over the place, but each of these elements play an important role in this song.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I'd like it if we could make this work somehow.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <What if you made it easier to differentiate between the motifs for the first and second verses?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah... Wait, hang on. That still ends up with me having to remove stuff.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But to be honest, the chorus still doesn't feel complete to me, so I want to try adding a little more sound...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I'm thinking that it'd be nice to have a denser sound to go along with some sort of effect for the illustration.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Alright, it's gonna take more materials than usual, but what if we split your draft into three layers...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah. We could have one for the motifs from the first verse and another for the second verse like Yuki said...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And have them all appear at once on the last layer!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, that might actually be pretty good.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Like when the main character from a manga goes to fight the final boss with their friends!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Sorry, Amia, I don't really get it either.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <In any case, you should rethink how many of these motifs you include where...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <As it stands, it's too much to process.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Okay, I get it. You don't have to rub salt in my wounds!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But Yuki... Can we chat for a minute after this? I thought it might be easier if we talked about your lyrics and discussed how we're both going to make changes.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Alright, Enanan, Yuki, you two can take care of how to divide up this draft into three layers.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I'm good with that too!
Man, this is gonna be so amazing!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Don't forget that we have to make a bunch of fixes first.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <But you're going to do them since it'll look better in the end, right...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hm? Hey, what's going on? Someone say something.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, it's nothing. Why don't we get back to work now?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Let's do it♪ See you two later, Enanan, Yuki♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Hm...? Well, whatever...
Anyway, Yuki, you ready?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <They're supposed to be for the night show, but how or when do you actually use them...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, they're supposed to light up!
But I don't know for sure since I thought it'd be fun to find out during the actual show.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, but if you get one of the lucky bracelets, it's supposed to light up like crazy!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Light up like crazy? What do you mean? Don't the regular ones light up just fine?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm pretty sure it's supposed to be almost blindingly bright and look like a rainbow.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And apparently there are supposed to be other effects in store for everyone besides these bracelets.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, you don't look so good.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Is it because of your curfew?
Maybe if you leave now...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'm okay...
I'll stay to watch until the end.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(It happened again...
It's that same feeling...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Kanade's hand... It feels a bit cold...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But warm at the same time... Why is that...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(And it isn't just her.
Ena, Mizuki, everyone... Whatever they're giving me feels... Nice...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (That same part of me...feels warm again...)

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: It's okay. I'm sure we can still get a bracelet from one of the mascots, so let's try looking for them. How does that sound?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
*Sob*
But the show's about to start! Why do you have to be such a big slowpoke, Daddy?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, did they come too late for the bracelets?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Looks like it...
I guess I'll have to just give her...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Huh? I can have your bracelet...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, you can have mine.
My friends and I can use the ones we got, so you and your dad can use this one.

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line:
I don't know what to say...
Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Not really. That was just to calm her down.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, I think it's about to start!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Wow...! Look at that! The Ferris wheel's all lit up!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hehe. Len and the others seem to be enjoying themselves.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Speaking of which, Otori mentioned how this is a place that makes everyone smile...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: This is it! Get your bracelets ready!

rows.Speaker: Girl's Voice
rows.Line:
Wow! Look, Daddy! Look!
Mine's so bright!!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Oh, it's the girl from just earlier...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, Mafuyu, that bracelet you gave her...! Doesn't this mean it's one of the lucky ones?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Then I was right to give it to her...
I'd rather not stand out by having anything like that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You sure? I kinda wanted you to have some fun too, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Me too... Mafuyu, why don't I lend you mine? It might help you enjoy the moment a little...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, wanna use mine too?
Then you can double the fun♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, Mafuyu, look!
That junior of yours is about to do something.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <That's amazing! She's making the sky sparkle...!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! I think those lights are all drones!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I think I understand a little better what Otori meant by this place making everyone smile.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Why is it that the voices of everyone around me sound so different...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes...
I was just a bit startled.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, we might get a better angle if we go over there! Wouldn't it be better to have the Ferris wheel in full view behind us? I bet we can grab some amazing pics!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, let's go! We can take a picture to commemorate our trip!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You too, Mafuyu.
If you keep spacing out like that, you're gonna get lost again.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Ena's hand feels the same as Kanade's... A bit cold... But warm at the same time...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Welcome home.
How was school today?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, actually, one of my classmates was asked by the teacher to solve a problem and she answered it perfectly.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: She even said that it was because I helped her study that one time and it made me really happy.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, is that so?
By the way, what's her name...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(Her name...?
She's hardly ever asked for names before...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Mafuyu...?
She's a friend from class, right?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
R-Right. Her name's Harada.
She's on the softball team and we sometimes walk home together...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Voice
rows.Line: Anyway, Mom, I'll be in my room for a little while to take care of some homework.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (She bombarded me with questions about school and my friends again...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Is it because I told her that I was going to a friend's house to rest when I was supposed to be taking that practice exam...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Anyway, I need to do my homework...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(That's it for homework...
But Mom still has my synthesizer...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I already let Kanade and the others know that it's going to be hard for me to work during the night, so I'll just send over what I have and go to bed...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I haven't been able to sleep at all lately...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Ever since that day... After I decided to not go and take that practice exam, I've been having trouble falling asleep.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Am I trying to make up for it somehow by studying more...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I'm in my bed and covered in blankets, but I still feel cold...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm okay. I just haven't been able to sleep is all...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So, can I sleep here for a little bit?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Mafuyu, would you like a pillow?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Isn't this one of the cushions that Mizuki brought over...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, it is... I'd like you to use it, if you'd like that is. I'm sure it'll be easier to fall asleep with it rather than without.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh no... We don't have any blankets... You might catch a cold if you don't have something covering you, Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Miku, we can try seeing if there are any around here and...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I want you here with me...
You and Len, Miku...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(I knew it...
This place doesn't feel cold...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <The hallway... I thought I just heard a noise...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But I already said that I'd be staying up a little late to work on my cram school assignments...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (She even made me soup as a midnight snack, so it shouldn't be that surprising to see me still up...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I should make sure that I don't forget to take any textbooks and such, then go straight to bed.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, about a week's passed since Mom last cleaned my room... She might come back to clean again tomorrow...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(I'm logged out of Nightcord...
And I'll shut down my computer...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I'll put it in my school bag and take it with me...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
That should be everything.
And I put my lyrics notepad in my bag.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (How much longer do I have to keep hiding this from her...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Um, Mafuyu...
Is there anything you're hiding from me?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
What...? No, nothing.
Why would I hide anything from you, Mom...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Can you say that while looking straight into my eyes?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, I'm not hiding anything from you. Again, Mom, why would I ever do that...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Then, what is the meaning of this?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Mafuyu? It's almost time for you to go to school. Do you have everything you need?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Good morning.
Oh, your hair's parted in the middle now. It's nice. You look much more mature this way.

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: Hehe. And I have you to thank for that, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: But I still feel kinda bad about asking you for advice about this. I know it must've seemed like something out of left field.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, I knew that you were very busy studying for exams, so I hope changing things up will help you stay motivated.

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: It definitely will! Lemme pay you back by getting you some delicious cake sometime!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, are you sure?
Then, I may just take you up on that.

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line:
Yes, I'm absolutely sure!
I'll look for a nice shop!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. I'll be looking forward to that very much.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (It definitely seemed like I was talking, but it felt like someone else was...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (And... What is this sensation...? I feel all light and foggy...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(Did I catch a cold again...?
But I'm not running a fever...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Asahina...
You had your hand on your forehead just now. Are you by chance not feeling well?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You don't seem to be running a fever...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(I knew it...
So, did I imagine that light and foggy feeling just now?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'm sorry, Hinomori.
I was just trying to move my bangs out of the way.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Huh...? I-I'm so sorry!
I didn't realize! I completely jumped to the wrong conclusion and...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's okay. I really appreciate your concern.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, you're so moth... It's like having an older sister.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, hang on. Hinomori, you actually have a younger sister. Is that how you usually check to see if she's running a fever...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, but Shii hardly ever catches a cold, so I've only ever done this a few times with her...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I see. Still, you show concern for others in a way that makes you seem like an older sister.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I can't help but admire that since I'm an only child.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you.
But I believe that you'd also make a wonderful older sister, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. From club to the student council, you do such an incredible job of looking after all your juniors.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're always willing to lend them your ear and they always seem so relieved after consulting you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I believe it's proof that they trust and think very highly of you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. I sure hope that's the case.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: However, high expectations mean having to produce good results, which makes me a bit nervous.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Have you ever thought that being an older sister is too tough?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hmm... Too tough...?
No, I can't say that I really have.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: When we were little, I was a little worried about Shii since she had some trouble making new friends. Luckily, she ended up meeting some wonderful companions.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: If anything, on more than one occasion, I felt rather feckless...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. In particular, after I started working as an idol, my hands became full with managing what I had to do.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I couldn't be there for her when she really needed me, which must've made her feel so lonely. On top of that, she had to plan things around me being an idol...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Honestly, I found the way Shii always stayed true to herself really encouraging.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It felt like I was being given so much, while I gave Shii so little.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: However... One time, she said, “You've given me so much”...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry.
I didn't mean to do all the talking.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, that's okay. Again, I'm an only child, so I really enjoy hearing stories about what it's like to have siblings.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Also, you made it clear just now that your younger sister means the world to you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, she does! She's the apple of my eye!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's so nice.
I wish I had an older sister who could say things like that about me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(Ena's like Hinomori...
She's an older sister with a younger sibling...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (She calls him a “little brother with attitude”, but they seemed really close.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Um, Yuki...?
How have things between you and your mom been recently?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But you need to tell us the next time something does happen...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (She shows a clear concern for others from time to time... That's usually when she seems the most like an older sister.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Oh, Mizuki also has a sister... But she's much older, lives abroad and hasn't seen her in a while...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I should head back to class...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You two put on such a great performance!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Miku, Rin? Is something the matter...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Miku and Len were concerned about all of you.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yes, and we wanted to see what the festival was like...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay. Then, let's check it out together!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. Shibuya Festa's almost over, but now might be a good time since there's less people out and about now...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Are you okay with that, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. I'd like to take a look as well. I hope you won't mind having us, Ena.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You too, Luka? Just be careful not to get seen, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. Nice. The more the merrier.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Alright, let's do a lap of the stalls.
I hope there's something you guys like, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What would Miku and the others want to see...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? Did that crepe stall catch your interest, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I saw a lot of people going there during the day.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Really?! A crepe stall might be perfect since you get to see them being made!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Since we're here, I'd like to make it so they can really see what's going on...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Oh, I can see just fine...
I like how it starts out as a blob.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Are you talking about the crepe batter?
The hot plate cooks it while they try to make it really thin.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <They're using that stick to spread it out. I didn't realize it would be used so elegantly...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Oh, you're right... It's getting bigger and bigger.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Is it supposed to be this thin?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: They'll place fruits and whipped cream on it before wrapping it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, and the crepe itself is super soft, so I think you're gonna really like it!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It might be good to also get something other than crepes. Would you like to see what else there is?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Yes, let's take a look.
Oh, what are those red things...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, those are called caramel apples.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I see. They're so cute. I like how shiny they are♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, they coat the apples in a glaze that uses red food coloring. We can get some if you want.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Our order should be done soon.
Mafuyu, are you going to get a crepe?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I still have the lunch I was given earlier.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wait, did you not have lunch?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
No, I wasn't feeling very good before.
I was worried that food would upset my stomach.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I see. I didn't realize...
Do you feel better now?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, I feel much better.
I should be able to eat now.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I think I'll try a crepe.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You got it!
Hey, buddy, whip up a really good one for her!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Thank you all very much.
I didn't know crepes were so good...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's so thin but so soft...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's interesting how light the crepe and whipped cream are. And a big helping of fruit makes it all the more delicious.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (It's been so long since I last had a crepe...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Still, seeing you eat a crepe seems strange... How is it?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Did you ask for this custard, Mizuki?
It's good. Not too sweet with a refined flavor.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Really? Awesome♪
But Rin's the one who actually asked for that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Is that so?
Thank you, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Is it because we're eating them together?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (It's already been a week since Shibuya Festa...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Mom asked how it was after I got home, but no other questions besides that since.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (She didn't seem too concerned about me going...)

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: Oh, Mafuyu, sorry to bother you during lunch, but do you have a minute?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Sure, how can I help you?

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: I couldn't get my head around the things we discussed in class. Would you mind helping me understand it better?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, that was pretty tricky.
I don't know if I'll be able to teach it to you properly, but I'll try my best. Let's sit down and talk about it.

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: Thanks for teaching me that part during lunch! It was super helpful and I'm really glad I asked you, Mafuyu!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Really? That's good to hear.
I was actually a little worried if I could explain it correctly.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Anyway, I need to head to club. I'll see you tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I didn't have time to eat much of my lunch...)
Oh, thank goodness we found her in time. Asahina!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, sorry if this seems sudden, but there's something we need to tell you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
How can I help?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: There's something about club that I'd like to discuss with you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, nothing's wrong. However, I just thought I should tell you that I may be a little late to club today.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We'll be holding a meeting to discuss ideas with the rest of MORE MORE JUMP! in just a bit, so I won't be able to make it to club until that's finished.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I see. That's understandable.
Feel free to come to club whenever you're ready.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And I'm sure you two will come up with some good ideas. I'll be rooting for you both.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you! We promise to do our best! Let's go, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Sorry about that.
Good luck with club, Asahina!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We'll need to come up with an idea for what to do just before our solo show.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. Ideally, it should be something fun that everyone can enjoy. Oh, what if we do a stream the day before where we just chat about whatever we like...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I have a feeling that our fans are also going to be anxious, so it might be a nice way to lighten the mood going into our show.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We worked very hard to make sure we're able to spread hope to as many people as we can.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, what if we all had our own solos during our next show?! How awesome would that be?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm glad that we all feel a little more confident now, but we still need to think about things seriously...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm not sure how it'll go, but I do want to give it a try...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: In that case, I can try singing with a little more power.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (They seem to be discussing their next show...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But now it's gone. What was that...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You were looking for me? What for?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, there's something I want to tell you! It's about how Rui got hurt...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: He says his arm's all better and that his foot doesn't hurt anymore! Also, you were right about it being just a light sprain!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I see. I'm glad to hear that Kamishiro's all better now.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, however... The pain may be gone, but he still should probably not do anything too strenuous for a while.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Right! Rui said that he's taking P.E. off, and we'll make sure he gets to sit and stay off it during practice!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hehe.
It sounds like he's in good hands.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Again, we really appreciate how you helped him! Thanks to your treatment, he should be back to being 100% in no time!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you for letting me know. Please send him my regards.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We're gonna do our best to make it so you smile like you did just now after seeing one of our shows...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Anyway, if you'll excuse me!
I need to head to practice!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (The problems they've been giving us at cram school lately have become more difficult...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I managed to solve them since I made sure to read up on everything beforehand...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I ended up making a simple calculation error...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(It's not just cram school...
I've been making some odd mistakes recently.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, about cleaning up the prep room. Are you sure you won't need more people?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Hm? No, that shouldn't be a problem. I thought you relayed that to your classmates earlier...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (That's right...! I did that before the break...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm sorry. It slipped my mind that I already asked you about that...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Hehe. It's okay, Asahina. We all forget things sometimes.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (My teacher didn't find that strange, but I need to be careful not to repeat the same mistake...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(Still, why did that happen...?
Have I not been getting enough sleep lately...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(Do I need to sleep more...?
But I have to study and review what we went over in cram school...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Also, I need time to work on...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: If you truly wish to do something, Mafuyu, you're free to do it...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Just don't regret your decision, okay...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Um...
Mom...? What are you doing...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sorry for borrowing your computer without asking first. I was just looking something up...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: How long do I have to...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (My chest... It feels so heavy... It hurts...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(I still have time until my curfew...
I should find a place to rest...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(No, it still hurts...
Isn't there anything that can relieve me of this...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I think I feel a little better...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(But my legs... They feel so heavy...
I need to get home soon, but...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Mafuyu...?
What are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Okay, Mafuyu, I'll be going now.
Please watch over the house for me while I'm gone.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. You should be able to really focus on studying since you don't have club activities today.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, I should be able to do all my homework and go over what we did during cram school.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: That's my daughter. But don't study too hard, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Thanks, Mom.
I'll make sure to take breaks here and there.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (What was I assigned for homework? Math and English...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Why is my computer still on...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, that's right... I was close to finishing my lyrics but decided to stop since I needed to go to sleep.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But there's really only a little bit left to do... I think I'll finish working on my lyrics since I might not be able to focus while studying if I leave them unfinished...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Hm? Hey, Yuki!
Fancy seeing you here at this time. Do you not have club or cram school today?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Amia... Yes, both are off today, so I decided to work for a bit.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Oh, sorry, I meant...!
It really is rare seeing you here at this time.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<So, wanna work together...?
Let's see... Based on the current time...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <But it's 11:37, so shouldn't you round up to 11:40?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Also, Yuki, there's something I noticed about you.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah! We've been meeting each other in real life more and more lately, but you're the only one who's been going over to everyone's houses.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And if you come over to my house, Yuki, you'll complete the N25 set.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hm? You don't seem all that interested... I'm really curious as to what everyone's rooms are like.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Because a person's room says a lot about who they are, right? I really like seeing and hearing about stuff like that!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah. For example, Enanan's room was pretty messy, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Same with K. She mentioned that she needs to clean her room more, but they're pretty similar, aren't they?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<No, they aren't...
Enanan's room was the furthest thing from organized, but it wasn't as cluttered as K's room.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah, that's what I'm talking about!
There's a clear difference between them!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Heehee. My room's immaculate!
I'm careful about where things go and always put things back where they belong!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Including my clothes.
I make sure to put them back in my closet instead of throwing them on the floor.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Yes, I had a feeling that your room is very tidy...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<See what I mean?
By the way, Yuki, what about your room?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<My room...?
It has a desk, a bed, a chest of drawers and a fish tank...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, I remember you mentioning that you're using it to grow seagrass or aquatic plants.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<There're tons of species, right?
What do you have in there right now?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Why am I talking about this right now...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I need to finish working on my lyrics so that I can study...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (And yet, this conversation... It's like I want to just...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Whoa, you're right...!
Sorry, Yuki. I didn't mean to ask you so many questions.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I know that I have a lot of things to do, but...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Hehe. Me too♪
Anyway, let's get back to work!>

rows.Speaker: Second-Year Archery Club Member
rows.Line:
You're doing awesome, Asahina!
If you keep this up, you might just win the individuals match.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. I appreciate it, but I can't let my guard down.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Just now, I released my arrow too soon after taking the draw position, so I'll need to fix that...

rows.Speaker: Second-Year Archery Club Member
rows.Line: And I need to fix my work ethic to be more like yours!

rows.Speaker: Second-Year Archery Club Member
rows.Line:
It's been ages!
What brings you here today?

rows.Speaker: Ex-Archery Club Third Year Student
rows.Line: I came to take a break from studying for exams. So, I decided to see my juniors practice. Mind if I watch?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Of course. Having you here should give us a nice motivation boost.

rows.Speaker: Ex-Archery Club Third Year Student
rows.Line:
Hehe. Don't mind me.
Also, where are Hinomori and the others...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hinomori's busy doing idol stuff with her group today.

rows.Speaker: Second-Year Archery Club Member
rows.Line: And the others are working on some stuff on their own!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But since you're here, why don't we try asking them to join us for a bit?

rows.Speaker: Ex-Archery Club Third Year Student
rows.Line: Are you sure? Then, if you don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you for coming to watch us practice today.

rows.Speaker: Second-Year Archery Club Member
rows.Line: And thank you especially for working with the first years.

rows.Speaker: Ex-Archery Club Third Year Student
rows.Line:
No, it was my pleasure.
I had a lot of fun today!

rows.Speaker: Ex-Archery Club Third Year Student
rows.Line: If anything, thank you all for allowing me to participate after dropping in on such short notice.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, you'll always be welcome here.

rows.Speaker: First-Year Archery Club Member
rows.Line:
Asahina's right!
Please drop by whenever you feel like you need a break from studying!

rows.Speaker: Ex-Archery Club Third Year Student
rows.Line:
Thanks!
Then, I might just bring by some nice treats for all of you next time.

rows.Speaker: Second-Year Archery Club Member
rows.Line: Alright, first years! It's time to start cleaning up!

rows.Speaker: Ex-Archery Club Third Year Student
rows.Line: Oh, second years, can we talk for a moment? I'm sure the teacher already let you all know...

rows.Speaker: Ex-Archery Club Third Year Student
rows.Line: About finding a first year who might make a good club captain and showing them the ropes.

rows.Speaker: Second-Year Archery Club Member
rows.Line: Wait, isn't it too soon for that?

rows.Speaker: Ex-Archery Club Third Year Student
rows.Line:
That's what we said last year.
Then, before we had a chance to prepare ourselves, the time came for us to retire.

rows.Speaker: Ex-Archery Club Third Year Student
rows.Line: Do your best and make the most of each day! Now, if you'll excuse me!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: O-Okay. Thank you for stopping by!

rows.Speaker: Second-Year Archery Club Members
rows.Line:
I hate to say it, but she's right...
If we're not careful, we'll be retiring before we even know it.

rows.Line:
Right...
But I'm looking forward to not having to practice every morning!

rows.Line: Haha! Relax! I was just kidding!

rows.Line:
(I feel cold...
But I definitely wiped off my sweat earlier...)

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line:
Me too!
But who made them?

rows.Line: They're so cute. The one in the middle's bigger than the others too. Do you think they're one big family?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, I'd like it if you could remember what we did today...

rows.Line: I'm sure that there are already plenty of people around you who are willing to give you their support.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I'd like it if you could remember that I'm also there for you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Huh? I don't feel as cold anymore for some reason...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(Is it just me?
With the wind and all, it's only supposed to get colder tonight.)

rows.Line: (Cram school ended much sooner than usual today since we had a short class...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But they gave us more assignments than usual, so I'll need to get started on those as soon as I can...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (And Mom's going to be home all day, so I probably won't be able to work on anything N25-related...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(...
For now, I should get home as soon as I can...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. It's so nice to run into you outside of school like this. Were you about to go somewhere?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, I was on my way home from cram school. What about you, Hinomori?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We have practice today as MORE MORE JUMP!, but I wanted to do some shopping first.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Remember how we ended up walking to the station together after I broke my umbrella?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, right... It did get bent pretty badly...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, it did. So, I'm here to buy a new one at this shop Airi showed me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I see.
I hope you find a nice replacement.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
But I hope I can find this shop before practice...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Do you not know where it is...?

rows.Line: So... Airi showed me the website for it, which listed its location... Unfortunately, I ended up getting lost...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I know what to do now! It's supposed to be right by the post office, so I just need to keep an eye out for that.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hang on... What if you end up finding the wrong post office?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Y-You're right...!
I would've gotten even more lost if I did! Thank you, Asahina!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Y-You're welcome...
Also, mind if I take a look at the shop on a map?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
A map? Sure, here you go.
It's the one from the website...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You're looking for the shop on Miyamasuzaka, right, Hinomori? This appears to be a map for a different branch.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What?! But Airi said it's right by the post office...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: There's one very close to the Miyamasuzaka branch. This is where we are right now, and the post office I think you're looking for is here. Which means the shop you wish to visit is this one.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I-It was under my nose this entire time?! Oh no... I feel so embarrassed...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, don't be. You managed to get this close by yourself. Also, you probably would've found it just fine if it weren't for this map.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I know. Hinomori, mind if I take a look inside with you?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Cram school ended early for me today, so I have some time on my hands.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, that's right.
Now, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you for helping me pick this out, Asahina! As a result, I was able to find a wonderful replacement umbrella.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I promise to cherish it for as long as I can.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad to hear that. Especially after we put quite a lot of thought into selecting it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, also, it's bigger than what you normally see.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I wanted one that I could share with others.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: With this, I'll be able to help Shii, Airi or anyone else who forgets to bring their umbrella.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That of course also includes you, Asahina!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. Remember how you helped me the other day?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'd like to return the favor the next chance I get.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Now, if you'll excuse me, I need to get to practice. Thank you for joining me today, Asahina!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Anytime. It was my pleasure.
See you again at school.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Okay, the lyrics are pretty much done. All that's left is to fine-tune them...)

rows.Line: <I'm logging off for the night. I'll probably have the lyrics ready for you by tomorrow.>

rows.Line: <Oh, wait! Would you mind staying up until midnight?>

rows.Line: <Once the clock strikes midnight, it's your birthday! We wanted to wish you happy birthday right on the dot.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <So that's why you were all online early.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Exactly. Hey, you could try sounding a little more excited, you know.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <The fact that it's my birthday doesn't make today any different. I think people at school might wish me a happy birthday, though.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And while you guys were busy chatting, look, it's five seconds 'til midnight!>
