rows.Line: <Alright. We'll put on a proper celebration for you another time!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Make sure you actually get some sleep tonight.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I should get some sleep.
Time to log out of Nightcord...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Classmate A
rows.Line:
Oh, good morning, Mafuyu.
Aaand, happy birthday♪

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Classmate B
rows.Line: Here, this is from us! They're lemon-flavored madeleines from the patisserie in front of the station! They're amazing!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you both! Oh, this is the place you told me about before, right? The one that went viral online?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Classmate A
rows.Line: Yeah! We tried them ourselves before buying them, and there's no denying that they're good!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Classmate B
rows.Line: Not only did we get to stuff ourselves there, but thanks to that we knew that these would be the perfect gift for you! Talk about a double win!

rows.Speaker: Junior Archery Club Members
rows.Line: Oh, Asahina, happy birthday! We got you a gift!

rows.Speaker: Junior Archery Club Members
rows.Line: Um...please accept my birthday gift, too!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you all so much for coming all the way to the second years' classrooms, and thank you so much for these gifts.

rows.Speaker: Junior Archery Club Members
rows.Line: Our pleasure, Asahina! We'll see you at club after school!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Asahina, are you free to talk for a moment?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hinomori? Oh, and Hoshino and Mochizuki...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Since it's your birthday today, I invited them over so that we could all give you our presents at the same time.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, they're gloves. Hehe, they look so thick and warm!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I thought you might need them since it's going to stay cold for a while. I hope they come in handy!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Of course. I'll be making good use of these.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Happy birthday. We also got something for you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We were really stuck on what to get you, but in the end, we settled for this deep sea snow globe.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, it looks like it's snowing underwater. It's so sparkly and pretty!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you, I'll make sure to treasure this!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm glad she likes what we got her!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, it's all thanks to Kanade's advice.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I'm sorry, Mafuyu. I need to apologize to you about something.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <A while ago, Hoshino and Mochizuki reached out to me asking what kinds of food you like so they can get you a birthday present.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I ended up saying that it's probably best to not get you anything food-related.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Anyway, they seemed to understand it as your dedication to your physical fitness, given your commitment to archery...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <...but I just wanted to apologize for having said too much. I'm sorry.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hoshino, Mochizuki, it sounds like you put so much effort into this.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: While I don't mind edible gifts, they disappear after I eat them, so I'm happy that I can keep this with me forever.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We should go thank Ms. Yoisaki, too!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I didn't expect to receive this many gifts. I should keep note of who gave me what before I forget—

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thank you for your time, Asahina!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No worries. Anyway, what is this special thing you were talking about?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Well! Since it's your birthday, I picked out the perfect short story that is sure to make you burst into laughter!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: <This is the start of a new year! I can't wait to do lots of fun activities with my friends!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: <Oh! I got a New Year's greeting card! Let's see what it says...>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
<Thanks for everything this year...
Looking forward to what next year brings...?>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: <Say what now?! The year's only just started y'know!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I assume it was supposed to be “thanks for everything last year” and “looking forward to what this year brings?” Maybe they weren't paying much attention to what they were writing?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hah...hahaha! Y-Yeah, that's probably what happened...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Did you come up with that short story yourself, Otori?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: N-No, I found it in a book at the library...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: U-Um... Asahina, I want to wish you a very happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'll try my best to make you laugh next time! Please look forward to it!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe, okay then. Feel free to ask me whenever you like. And thank you for that birthday surprise.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I didn't know there was a book about funny stories in the library...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I should head back to class.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That's because there are other customers around.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But the noise makes it harder for others to overhear you. Plus, we got seats at the back, so you're less likely to be seen.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, in that case, we don't have to keep a low profile.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Not at all. We all wanted to celebrate together.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Well, since you guys are all here now...
Mafuyu, once again, happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
The food's all here too! Let's eat♪
Mafuyu, tell me if there's anything you want, okay?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Kanade, you're a bit far from the french fries. Shall I get some for you?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <It's also time for us to dig into these treats you all brought us for this occasion.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: By the way, Mafuyu. Was everything okay with Hoshino and Ms. Mochizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yeah, they didn't mention anything about it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's about my birthday present. Two juniors at my school asked Kanade what kind of things I like so they could get me a present.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <So in other words, Kanade gave them advice about you, right? And what did they get?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: A snow globe. It was a deep sea-themed one and very pretty.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, was it Ichika and Honami who got you that gift by any chance?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yeah... I also got a lot of gifts from the juniors from archery club.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Speaking of juniors, Otori also tried to make me laugh by telling me a short story.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh! And what was the story about?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay then, I think it went like this...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! They seriously wrote “thanks for everything this year” on a New Year's greeting card? That does sound like their brain was somewhere else.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe, I wouldn't be surprised if lots of people have done that before.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Mizuki, watch out for your drink. You might knock it over with your arm.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I got the joke, but was it really funny enough to be flailing your arm around like that?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I just thought it was a story about some careless mistake.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I hope the person who made the mistake doesn't feel sad...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Um...well, it seems that the card really made its recipient laugh. If the sender only knew, I'm sure it'd make them happy.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Like Rin said earlier, it's a little noisy here...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (For now... I guess I don't hate it.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Asahina. Ena may be quite a handful to deal with, but I hope your friendship with her continues to grow.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Asahina, happy birthday! I'll make sure to show you that book of short stories sometime! There are loads of good ones in there!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Asahina. I'm so glad you liked the present we got you!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It turns out we knew pretty much nothing about what you like or your hobbies... Next time we go out to eat together, let's talk about more than just music.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe, that sounds lovely. Asahina, we only ever get to talk at archery club. How about we go get lunch together sometime so we can have a proper chat?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mafuyu, happy birthday. You've become better at talking more openly about your feelings and I can see that you're putting in the effort.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! I know you've got a lot on your plate from school, but hit me up if you ever want to take a break! We'll accompany you anywhere and everywhere♪ Right, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Um... I'll try, as long as it doesn't involve any strenuous activities.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Mafuyu.
I promise to make a song that will save you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, I look forward to you hearing it someday. Wishing you a happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: How strange... I didn't really feel anything because it was my birthday. And yet...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't know how to describe it...but it's not unpleasant.

rows.Line: Make sure to keep your shoulder down when you draw your arrow back. Stay calm, focus and take it slow...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, that was excellent...
You remained focused through the release and follow-through.

rows.Speaker: Archery Club Member
rows.Line:
Phew... Thanks, Asahina.
I should be able to keep my shoulder from rising on its own now.

rows.Line: At the same time, I feel really bad about having you watch me practice. I know you have cram school after this...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That's okay. I was actually hoping to get in a little practice as well.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So, I think I'll get started.

rows.Speaker: Archery Club Member
rows.Line: Okay! Thank you for the advice!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I have some free time until cram school starts now. That means I can keep shooting...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Thankfully, Mom's not stopping me from going to club...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Are those poems also a part of your homework...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Because you know what you have to do in order to make your dream come true.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
I need to breathe...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (This shot is all you care about right now...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Did cram school always end this early...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I wish I kept practicing for a little while longer...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(I still have time until curfew...
Maybe I can stop by somewhere before I head home...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Somewhere to take my mind off things... But...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Where can I go to relax that's also close by...?)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If you're willing to give up after just that, then it's obviously not important enough.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
But that's not the case, is it?
So quit lying to yourself.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm not lying to myself... I...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I should go to bed...
Mom said that I need to stop staying up late to study...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: She's doing everything she can to destroy who you really are. How can you even think about showing her any mercy?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, come on. Open your eyes.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You know exactly what she's trying to do. But you just keep—

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I just need to fall asleep. Then, I won't have to think about all this...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I don't want to think about all of this...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I just want it all to stop...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But I'm not supposed to work on...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Wait...
I can listen to something...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Why do Kanade's songs all feel so...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(Oh, it ended...
I think I'll listen to it again...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Is it the new demo Kanade sent over the other day...? I'd forgotten that I downloaded it to my phone to listen to later...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (The melody... It's so beautiful and calming... The atmosphere it creates makes me want to...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
No, I need to stop...
Mom said that I need to sleep...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I thought that pain was finally gone...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The volume... I just need to raise it higher...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I want to keep listening to Kanade's song...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I want to keep writing lyrics for her...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(I should keep the lights turned off...
I can take notes on my phone for now...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (How do I put this part into words...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(That's all of my homework...
I've reviewed everything else, so I just need to go to sleep now...)

rows.Line:
<No, Yuki, we're glad you're here.
The lyrics you wrote were incredibly good.>

rows.Line:
<Yeah, I agree! Oh, also!

rows.Line: <Slow down, Amia. Don't my illustrations come first?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I know, but it's still good to ask, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Oh, I might want to message them before I do...)

rows.Line: <Sorry for not responding sooner, but I won't be able to do anything today. I'll try working on my lyrics tomorrow if I have time.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I need to find some time to work on my lyrics...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <That's okay. In the meantime, I'll keep working on our song.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I drew a rough sketch based on the theme we chose, so I'll send it over to you. K said it was okay, but let me know if it's not what you were going for...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <We've still got plenty of work left to do, so don't worry! You work at your own pace, Yuki!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I need to get to school a little early tomorrow...)

rows.Line: (The class representatives are supposed to create a summary of their ideas and submit it to the teachers. After that...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (A chat message...? Oh, it's from Mizuki...)

rows.Line: <What if you logged onto Nightcord to work on stuff while you're at school during lunch?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But I have student council business to take care of during lunch. Also, the teachers are always asking for my help...)

rows.Line: <I don't know if that's going to work...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Various people are always asking for my help during the day.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <But thank you for making this suggestion.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(They're trying to accommodate me.
They want to work with me...)

rows.Line: (That gesture alone is more than enough...)

rows.Line: <What if you said you want to use your school's studying room to work on your cram school assignments and stuff?>

rows.Line: <Can't you log into Nightcord on your phone and act like you're doing your homework?>

rows.Line: <Mafuyu, you listen to us chatting while responding through text.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <But it could be worth a try.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Let's just try it once to see!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<Then, I'll talk to you all tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I'll need to keep my lunch free tomorrow.)

rows.Line:
*Sigh*

rows.Line: I couldn't believe it when I saw you skating backwards, Mafuyu!

rows.Line: But you were doing the same thing.

rows.Line: Hehe. Despite how I look, I'm actually pretty athletic!

rows.Line:

Anything catch your eye?

rows.Line:
<Sorry, I know it's late.

rows.Line: <We can meet whenever you're free by the way! Still, I do sorta want to see you sooner rather than later...>

rows.Line: <There's something I need to tell you.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (What exactly does Mizuki want to tell me...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (It sounded important. Enough to be asked to meet in person.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You're pretty good at ball sports, right, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I can play the ones we did during P.E.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
What else do they have...?
A punching machine, tennis... Oh, they even have a pitching machine!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
What do you say, Mafuyu?!
Wanna try one of those?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We can play whatever you want, Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha. Thanks!
But since we're both here...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Why don't we do a lap of the place and see if anything catches your attention?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: They have a futsal court over there and... Hey, check it out!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Those people are wearing balloon-looking suits!
That's probably the bubble sumo thing Kanade and Ena were talking about!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, I can see. They're bigger than I thought...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, it can't be easy to run and dodge people with one of those on. Oh no! That person got bounced away! Haha!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Man, that looks like so much fun though...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Do you want to give it a try, Mizuki...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I do! But we'd have to sit around and wait until they're done, so let's keep looking in the meantime!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, this arcade's got a decent lineup!
I'm seeing a ton of fun-looking games!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, we could try our hand at the claw machines and win the others some souvenir plushies!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Didn't Ena say that the claws are too weak?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, she did!
At the same time, Ena could've been going about it all wrong.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: While we're on the subject, did Ena tell you what happened afterwards? Li'l Bro's friend is really good at winning stuff from those machines!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, I know them because we go to school together.
But anyway, she asked through Li'l Bro how to win that plushie and even sent pics showing what was going on.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: There's that, but she also really hates losing, you know?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Still, I remember her finishing with them not winning anything.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: They didn't that time. But I heard that Li'l Bro's friend was nice enough to go and win it for her.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Also, Mafuyu, are there any plushies here that you wanna win?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha. Figured...
At the same time... I'm not seeing anything good either.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Let's keep looking around!
Where have we not gone yet...? Oh, over there!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I know! Kanade and the others said they played strike zone! It should also be over there!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I'm not sure Mizuki's ready to have that talk yet...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Oh, Yuki, thank you for joining us.
Shall we get started then?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<*Yawn*
Amia, I'm sending over that illustration I was working on yesterday...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(Did Ena just wake up?
She sounds sleepy...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hm? Hey, Enanan, this looks like the same illustration from the day before. Are you sure you sent me the right file...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Hey, cut me some slack.
I worked really hard to get this to you today.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, I noticed that you worked all through the night. Thank you for being so diligent, Enanan.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Hear that, Amia?
That's what I was hoping for.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I was hoping that you'd send me the right file.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Sorry, I need to head back to class...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: There's something I need to mention before I go...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yuki? Are you sure you should be talking?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
It's fine.
Nobody else is here right now.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Anyway, it's about next week.
We have our school trip, so I may log on at a different time instead of lunch.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<While you're on your trip?
You really don't have to. I mean, I feel that you should try to enjoy your school trip.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, it's okay... That's what I want to do.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Well, if you're sure...
By the way, where are you guys going?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Cool! A classic school trip destination♪ Are you gonna go see Kiyomizu-dera Temple and stuff?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That's one of the options... But I'm going to pick the traditional crafts workshop with my classmates.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, that sounds like fun! What do you get to make?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I haven't heard any details.
But it seems it includes making pottery with a wheel and dyeing fabrics.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Nice! I hope you guys get good weather!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The weather shouldn't matter since it takes place indoors.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Nah, these kinds of activities are always more fun when it's nice out.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I should learn more this week about our schedule, so I'll let you all know soon...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, and bring something back for us if you can.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hey, I said, “If you can,” didn't I?! And I wasn't talking about just us. She has Miku and the others to also think about.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, right! They're pretty worried about you, Yuki. You're so nice to point that out, Enanan.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Shut it, Amia.
Again, if you can. Some food for thought...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: This is nice. It feels like a quintessential Japanese inn.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Yeah, we should be able to relax plenty here! Oh, dibs on the back corner.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: That's fine and all, but you don't toss and turn in your sleep, do you? Try not to kick a hole in the sliding door, okay?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
No, I won't!
Mafuyu, they're teasing me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. Alright, you two, no teasing her while we're on vacation.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Hey, no fair. You don't get to hog Mafuyu!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Come to think of it, didn't you three say that you were going to take a bath before dinner?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Yeah, that's right! Let's get changed!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Okay, calm down.
Oh, Mafuyu, are you sure you don't want to join us...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like to take this opportunity to do some research on where we'll be going tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Classmate C
rows.Line: Okay! Then, we'll go on ahead without you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hey, Yuki! Are you at the inn already?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes... My classmates just went to take a bath, so my plan is to work for a little after looking up where we'll be visiting.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Okay. Then, I think we should be okay on our end...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Miku? Are you with Kanade right now?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yes... I heard that if I waited, I'd get to talk to you, Mafuyu...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Would you mind if I visited you over there?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
On my phone...?
That's okay, if just for a little bit...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I'm glad to hear that, but you need to keep an eye out for other people.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Miku, what's the inn like?
Mind describing it for us?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Haha.
Yeah, it is meant for four people.>

rows.Speaker: Ena's Message
rows.Line: <Sorry, I'm still at school, so I can't do much right now. Mind getting these for me if you can find them?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<She posted a link and everything...
Hm? Custard cream sandwiches? Hey, these look amazing!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I think I saw an advertisement for these on the way over. They shouldn't be too difficult to find...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Really? I guess it is like Enanan to have you get something that's readily available.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
What about you two...?
Is there anything either of you would like me to get?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Me? No, I hadn't given that any thought.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I have a request!
But you don't have to bother if it feels like too much trouble. Here's a link!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Warabimochi? They usually have a short shelf life, but finding some should be fairly easy...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Is there anything you'd like for me to get you, Miku...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I'll be happy with whatever you decide to get, Mafuyu...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You will...? Then, I'll try to find something nice.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
It's already the last day...
Time really flies, huh?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, and we should buy some souvenirs before we forget.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Right! With those, it'll still feel like we're on vacation for a few more days!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm thinking about buying these sweets for some friends. Are there any large souvenir shops near here?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Oh, those monaka! It's so cute how they're shaped like animals. I think I'll get some for my juniors!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Yeah, and their flagship branch is between us and Kyoto Station. Let's check it out on our way over!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, we'll go to a big shop, then the monaka shop.

rows.Speaker: Classmate C
rows.Line: Alright, let's make the most of our last day!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Welcome home, Mafuyu.
Do you get your finals back?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I'm afraid of what she's going to say when she sees that my grades are starting to slip.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Not just say... What she might do...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (And I have another mock exam coming up.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Doing well on that might make up for how I did on my finals...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But Mom might worry if I don't get enough sleep... Then, my only other choice is to study at school during my breaks...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (If I do that, my lunch break will...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <What if you logged onto Nightcord to work on stuff while you're at school during lunch?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I know not being able to talk is gonna be tough, Yuki, but let's try to get as much done as we can!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<She'll be fine.
I mean, she doesn't talk much to begin with.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Message
rows.Line: <Conversely, Enanan, you don't know when to stop.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Hey, what's that supposed to mean?!
We need to communicate if we want to produce good content, right?!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (If I don't do well on my next exam...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (That means I need to study during lunch...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (And I should let the others know...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I'm sorry, but I need to take a break from N25 for a while...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I won't be able to talk with them until I've finished taking my next exam... I won't be able to work on any music...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I... I don't want to send this message... I want to keep making music with them...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I should open the window and...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Mafuyu, do you have a minute?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I'm sorry, but I was wondering if you'd like to take a bath first or have dinner... Oh?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Your window's open. Is something wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, no... I just felt like getting some fresh air...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: A bath or dinner? I think I'll have dinner first. I'm actually feeling hungry all of a sudden.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Hehe. Okay.
Then, I'll get everything ready.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: It shouldn't take long, so please get changed sooner rather than later.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I will. I'm looking forward to dinner.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Thank goodness I was able to hide my phone in time...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Did I press send by accident while trying to hide my phone...? Wait, I should still have time to delete it...)

rows.Speaker: Ena's Message
rows.Line: <A while? How long are we talking here?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Message
rows.Line: <Do you need some extra time to study?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Message
rows.Line: <I probably won't be able to join you all until my next mock exam is over.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Message
rows.Line: <It's okay. You don't need to apologize. I'll at least be working, so I can just stay logged into Nightcord starting tomorrow so that you can join whenever.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Message
rows.Line: <Yeah, me too♪ You don't necessarily have to get a lot done, so come hang out anytime!>

rows.Speaker: Ena's Message
rows.Line:
<Then, I think I'll stay logged on too.
Come online whenever you feel like it, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Message
rows.Line:
<Thank you.
I'll try to log on if I have time.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Mafuyu...
If you don't fight back now, this is probably going to be it for you.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Fight back. Tell her how you really feel.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <No one can predict what's going to happen, but this is the only option you have right now.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(I have to tell her...
She needs to know how I feel...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <You're not feeling afraid after coming this far, are you...?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I know I have to tell her...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Ugh... Just poking our heads out is starting to become a struggle.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I'm not going back. Not a chance. Not until I've seen you tell your mom what she needs to hear.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <It's okay. We'll be right by your side until you can tell your mom how you really feel...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I wish I could hold your hand...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Her hands... They feel warm for some reason... But that doesn't make any sense. She's a hologram...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm sorry about that. I'm okay now...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Don't worry...
We'll be with you every step of the way...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (She needs to hear how I really feel...)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Thank you for helping me, Asahina.
You're a real lifesaver.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm glad I could be of service.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
You should still have time to have lunch.
Please make sure to rest before afternoon classes begin.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Thank you, I will.
Now, if you'll excuse me...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I hope the school store still has something available...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: To be fair, it's already lunch.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Did you two just get here...?
Does that mean you had work this morning?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, we were at a shoot for a TV show.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Weren't you on TV just the other day?
It's like I'm seeing you all wherever I go now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you.
But we're usually invited on as guests, so we're trying to make the most of each opportunity.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Even when the cameras are squarely on us, we don't get nearly as much airtime as the other idols and personalities.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Right. Being an idol sure sounds like hard work.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. But this is what we want to do, so we're willing to work as hard as we need to.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: By the way, Asahina, have you eaten already?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh...
No, not yet. I was helping a teacher just now...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Then, that's perfect.
Why don't we have lunch together?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank goodness the school store still had so many things available.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But your choices...
I mean, who buys a plum rice ball with an egg salad sandwich...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's because I thought I'd get hungry again if I only bought one.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Also, Asahina, is that tuna sandwich going to be enough for you?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes. I didn't have practice this morning, and I don't usually get that hungry after just studying.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That reminds me... We saw a few first-years talking about visiting clubs and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And it sounded like they already knew which clubs they wanted to join.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Most of the ones who came to visit the archery club picked up a bow and wore the protective armor for the very first time. But they seem eager to get familiar with everything as fast as they can.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I saw that as well when I went to visit the other day. Their eyes sparkled with so much excitement.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That reminded me of when I first observed the archery club. It was quite nostalgic.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Nostalgic...? Wasn't that only two years ago? You sound like a doting grandma talking about her grandchildren.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: A grandma...? I can easily see Hinomori elegantly sipping tea while sitting by a Japanese garden.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, how did you know?
I love having tea by our garden.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Haha! I guess Grandma here can't really help it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Why are you two laughing?
Please tell me. I don't want to be left out.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, we should head back to our classrooms.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank you for joining us for lunch, Asahina. That was really fun.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, thank you for inviting me.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's have lunch together again sometime!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (The student council starts back up again today. I ended up becoming a class representative after the teacher and my classmates fervently asked me to...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I guess the one positive about this is that I don't have to get used to a new committee or anything...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. As energetic as ever I see.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Since you're here, am I correct in saying that you've also become a class representative?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, also...? Are you one too?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes. Everyone asked me to, so I decided to be one again this year.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow... Even after changing classes, everyone believes that you'll do a good job of representing them!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's so amazing. I feel like you're one of those really reliable and hard-working people who are destined to lead...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: My goal is to make sure Phoenix Wonderland keeps being a place that puts smiles on everyone's faces forever and ever!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And in order to make that happen, my brothers suggested that I become a class representative. They said it'll be a good experience for me!

rows.Speaker: Second-year
rows.Line:
Oh, Asahina!
You're gonna be a class representative again?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, I see you are as well. It's nice to see a familiar face.

rows.Speaker: Second-year
rows.Line: Likewise! I really had a lot of fun last year!

rows.Speaker: Third-year
rows.Line:
Wow, that's so pure and simple.
I'm doing this to try to boost my grades.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You say that, but you worked really hard last year and even stayed late after school often to put documents together.

rows.Speaker: Third-year
rows.Line: Haha! A part of me probably just doesn't want you to hog all the glory, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, Otori, I'm sorry.
These two are also class representatives.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: They have quite a lot of experience now, so I'm sure they'll be able to teach you whatever you need.

rows.Speaker: Third-year
rows.Line: Otori...? Oh, didn't you work really hard on the sports festival last year with Haruka Kiritani last year?

rows.Speaker: Third-year
rows.Line: Everyone from the planning committee said you guys came up with a lot of great ideas and made things really fun in the end.

rows.Speaker: Second-year
rows.Line:
Wow...!
Then, we're really lucky to have you as a class representative!

rows.Speaker: Second-year
rows.Line: Let's do our best to make this school year a fun one.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah☆ You can leave making everyone smile to me♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I... I...!
I'm going to do everything I can to make it happen!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Yes, let's do our best together.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Sorry for making you be here, Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
Don't worry about me.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: More importantly, I'm glad your dad was willing to understand. This means you can settle in over at my house for the meantime...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Your tea's gone cold...
Let me make a new cup for you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Then, if you're okay with answering...

rows.Speaker: Honami's Voice
rows.Line:
Ms. Yoisaki, it's me, Mochizuki.
I'm here again as scheduled.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Voice
rows.Line:
Huh? Asahina...?
What are you doing at Ms. Yoisaki's house...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(Oh, right...!
I forgot that she's scheduled to work today...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh no! Don't move, Ms. Yoisaki!
I'll clean this up right away...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you for your patience.
Here's your tea.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you...
I'll try it now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Still, I was so surprised when I saw that she was here...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I-I'm sure you were... Sorry, I didn't mean to startle you...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, please. You don't have to apologize...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: By the way, Asahina, how are you feeling?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
It's just...
I heard that you were taking a few days off after catching a cold.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'm okay.
It wasn't actually a cold.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Um, Ms. Mochizuki, the thing is...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Alright, I will be excusing myself here.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll see you at school, Asahina...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I'm really sorry, Mafuyu...
I completely forgot that Ms. Mochizuki was scheduled to come over today...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
That's okay.
Someone was bound to find out sooner or later.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But this might make things easier for us...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I felt really bad about having you leave each time Ms. Mochizuki came over...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I do agree with you...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Shall we have some of that food Ms. Mochizuki just made?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Now I just need to leave the house...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I'll get there too early if I leave now...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(Why is that...?
I'd be leaving more or less at my usual time.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I could have breakfast... But I'm not all that hungry.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Right. I always had breakfast with Mom before I left until now. That must be why I have some extra time on my hands...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I wanted to get an early start today...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Would you like some breakfast?
That should help you become fully awake.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Good idea...
Ms. Mochizuki has been saying that I need to eat more properly...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, I'll have a quick bite...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Then, I'll start getting everything ready.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Let's see... First, I need to put out some plates...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Then, I need to take the food Ms. Mochizuki made out of the fridge...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: These look like the boiled greens... This looks like that fish and vegetable stew...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'll grab some plates for them, heat up the fish and...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: O-Okay. Then, I'm sure you'll want some jam to go with that. Where did I put them...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
The jam should be on that shelf.
The butter's towards the top of the refrigerator, so I'll grab that as well.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Why don't you go wash your face in the meantime?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, okay. In that case, I'll be right back.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, see you in a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
All done...
Oh, so are you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I-I'm really sorry... I didn't mean for you to get everything ready for us.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: All I had to do was heat up the food.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, right... You have to get to school.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, this is nice since I don't usually eat many when left to my own devices.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I think Mochizuki made this because she wants you to eat healthier, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I noticed that most of the dishes she made has vegetables.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm guessing that's because you rely only on instant noodles.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, you may be right...
I should thank her the next chance I get.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, also...
What time do you think you'll be returning from school today?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I have to go to club today, so I may not be back for a little while...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
You have club today?
Then, I'll make it so you can take a bath right when you get back.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll be working as usual, so please let me know if you need anything.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I've felt it before. But where?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Things aren't as lively as they were at that time...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You didn't have much, Mafuyu? Are you sure that's going to be enough?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, since I wasn't actually all that hungry.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I'm glad we got to have breakfast together.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, that sounds nice.
Oh, let me help you this time.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mafuyu, your dad should be coming over soon. Which tea do you think I should make today?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Sorry, what did you just say...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, I was just thinking about brewing some tea. We have chamomile and a bunch of other varieties.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I know that I should go home...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And if I don't, my dad has to keep...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's okay for you to take things slow, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And I think he's allowing you to stay here because he feels the same way.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, that might be him...
I'll go check...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I feel like I've been resting for too long. It's been two hours since Dad left...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: It's okay for you to tell me whatever it is that's on your mind, Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't actually like this cake.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I haven't been able to taste anything for a while now...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Should I have told him those things...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I even told him how I couldn't taste that cake...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I should eat it sooner rather than later...
But Kanade might be working right now...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Do you feel better after resting...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Is something on your mind, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Umm...
Are you worried about telling him how you couldn't taste this cake?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: He said he wanted to know how I really felt...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But that might've just caused him to worry even more...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Your dad has every right to be surprised after hearing that...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But he also said that he'll be back to see you again next week...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, for now, I think you should feel good about telling him.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Done...!
What do you think, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
I'm also finished!
Here, take a look!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You both did fine in terms of grammar... And your spelling... Also looks good.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Thank you so much!
I really appreciate your help since I'm so terrible at subjunctives.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
But you still have these grammar problems about relatives left to do.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Urgh...
I think I'm worse at those...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Don't worry!
We have Mafuyu here to help us if we get stuck!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Is Asahina here?
I'd like her help with something...

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Sorry, she's helping us study right now!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Please don't take her away from us!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Ah, I see.
Understood. You three are welcome to continue studying.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Honestly, why can't they just deal with things on their own?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: I know, right? They rely on you way too much, Mafuyu. Okay, to be fair, we're in no position to talk...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Hey, we're allowed to because we're friends! Right, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I do believe that friends should also encourage each other to be independent.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (In the afternoon, I have classes and that student council meeting... But I might be able to leave early since we don't have club activities today...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm alone right now, so it's okay for you to come out...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, I didn't realize Len was with you.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<H-Hi...
Miku said she was going over to see you and...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I see...
Anyway, what brings you both here?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<No reason in particular...
We were wondering how you've been doing since we haven't spoken much lately.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, I haven't been over there in a little while...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'm sorry...
I've been focusing on our latest song for the most part...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We'll come over to show you all the finished product once it's complete...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<So, uhh...
What were you doing just now...?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I was planning on eating this bread I bought for lunch...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But I'd completely forgotten since I don't have much of an appetite...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Sorry, Mafuyu...
We didn't mean to keep you from having lunch...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
That's okay.
I don't necessarily have to eat right at this moment.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Wait, you're not eating?!
But aren't you hungry...?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I promise not to interrupt you eating... So, can I talk to you for a little bit longer?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I'd like to talk more as well...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
That's fine.
I'll talk while I eat...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I have more of an appetite compared to a second ago.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Happy New Year. Let's make the most of it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Phew...!
This juice tastes amazing! Ena, gimme a refill♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hey, don't chug.
This is good juice from a famous shop.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Were you the one who bought this juice, Ena?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Uhh... I pilfered it from one of our New Year's gifts... But it's all the same since I'm the one who brought it!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
U-Uh oh... I also finished my glass...
I didn't know this juice was so precious, Ena...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? No, you don't have to be so apologetic!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Here, I'll pour you another glass.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What? Why'd I get the third degree?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, KAITO, where are you going?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The new year's here. I'll be leaving now...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I mean...
I know I asked you to “at least” come for the countdown...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But this party's just getting started!
We've still got snacks to eat and New Year's resolutions to talk about!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
The rest of you enjoy doing that.
I'll also be going now.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Those two never change.
They really should stay and enjoy the party. Don't you agree, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Not really. They should come and go as they please.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: To be fair, shouldn't we be glad they at least stayed for the toast?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah...
But I kinda wanted them to enjoy all the decorations and things I brought over.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, so you brought the decorative bamboo and mochi...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! We can use these to bring some cheer and luck to SEKAI♪

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
A Kadomatsu...
It's decorative bamboo that you place outside your house to welcome in the deities.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I see...
The flower on it is pretty...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And this is called kagami mochi...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Why's there a mandarin on top...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I think they used to put bitter oranges on top in the past... Here, lemme look it up.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Snacks that taste like New Year's brunch also seem like something you can only enjoy during this time of year.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: They've got this strange but addictive taste to them! I can't stop eating them for some reason♪

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: We got so focused on eating them that other time that we stopped even talking.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (At first, there was no one else here besides me and Miku...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Are you enjoying the party, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't know if I'm enjoying it...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I do like that we're spending time together...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (These lyrics still need a few adjustments...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Based on this sound, the chorus should...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, I just received a message from someone from club... She wished me a slightly belated Happy New Year.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, New Year's greetings...
Ms. Mochizuki and Hoshino also sent me some.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Greeting others during this time of year does feel kind of special...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
It's nothing...
I already replied to her message, so I'll get back to work now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Before you do, why don't we take a quick break...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: We've been working for quite a while now... Plus, I'm hungry...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Then, let's have some of that mochi my grandma sent me for New Year's. There should still be enough...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We used up what was left when we made mochi soup this morning...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Then, why don't we go out and buy some more?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But it's so cold out. It's rare for you to volunteer to go out when the weather's like this...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I can just go instead and buy whatever we need.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Th-The cold might help wake me up...
So, I'll go with you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm starting to run low on a few daily necessities too, so you'd probably have trouble carrying everything back all on your own.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I knew that Mizuki's sister would be there with Mizuki at the New Year's sales, but I never expected to actually meet her...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: She seemed like a nice person.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: She felt a little like Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I thought the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Speaking of which...
Mizuki gave you that really nice scrunchie.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I thought the modest color would suit you well, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I thought it'd look great on you the second I saw it, Mafuyu! That's why I really wanna see you with it on!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Plus, it's cute and fashionable...
It could help change the way you feel a little.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm not sure how it's going to look on me...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I'll try it on later...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
They also seemed to really enjoy the sales.
They were both carrying around so many bags...that...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Sorry, Mafuyu, could we stop for a second? Let me just adjust my grip and...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, that's okay. You're already carrying most of the heavy stuff, so I don't want to increase your burden...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, I think I should carry those...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: How have you been getting all your shopping done until now, Kanade...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Until now...? Ms. Mochizuki's been doing all the grocery shopping... And my list of daily necessities was fairly short since I lived alone...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I may've gone a bit overboard today since I knew we'd be carrying everything back together...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm sorry for making you carry all the heavy things...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's okay. They're not actually that heavy.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Still, it may be a good idea to go to the store more often and reduce how many things you buy during each trip.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'll go with you if you feel it's necessary...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's not like you to be in the kitchen at this time.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I was working, but I got hungry...
So I came to get something to eat.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I was about to heat something up. Do you want some?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But... Maybe I'll have a little.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay. It'll be ready in a second.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: By the way... You're up pretty early today. Do you have something at school?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I have a student council meeting.
Apparently, our teacher has something to discuss with us.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Really? Being on the student council sounds pretty tough...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I've been doing it so long that I'm used to it, but... It's not that hard.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, yeah. I forgot something important...
Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (That's right... It's my birthday today. I forgot.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But... It feels kind of strange saying it to you in the morning like this.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father's Message
rows.Line:
<Happy birthday, Mafuyu.
I hope you're feeling well despite this cold weather.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father's Message
rows.Line: <I'll bring your present the next time I come by Ms. Yoisaki's apartment to see you.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I have to get to the meeting...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Good morning, Otori.
I see you're already raring to go, as usual.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: There's still time before the student council meeting... Why the hurry?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Good question! Today's your birthday, right?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: This time I'm gonna do it! I've got a funny story that'll definitely make you...smile...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Um...! Could you stick out your hands for me?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thank you! May I please hold them?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Her hands are so much smaller than mine... They don't even wrap the whole way around.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I just cast a powerful cheerfulness spell on you, Asahina!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
That's right☆
Now you're definitely gonna spend the rest of the day with a smile on your face!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, but, um... You shouldn't force yourself to smile either...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
But it is your once-in-a-year birthday!
So please have lots and lots of fun today!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Also, Tsukasa and Rui told me to pass on their birthday wishes too!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I see. Please tell them I said thank you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yes, you can count on me!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe... Let's do our best in the student council meeting☆ I'm gonna go ahead and go inside!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I think she was showing concern for me.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you. I'll see you later.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Good morning, Asahina. Do you have a moment?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Good morning, Hinomori. I do, but...
Why are you all here?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Well, we were on our way to give you a birthday present when we ran into these three in the corridor.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And so we decided we may as well come here together. Only...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I think it would be easier to explain once we hand over the presents.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Here you go. This is from Shizuku and me! Happy birthday, Asahina!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, now please accept this from us!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honami couldn't make it since her committee called a sudden meeting... But she and all of us worked together to pick this out for you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Would you mind if I opened them now?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
From Momoi and Hinomori...
Oh, it's a blanket. And it has a lovely design.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Groan*
Yes! We got you the same thing as Airi and Shizuku...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We were talking in the corridor just now when we realized what we'd done.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hehe, is that so?
But... I'm very happy with both these blankets.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Momoi and Hinomori's has a minimalist design, so it won't stick out too much in school...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And the other blanket is soft and looks very warm. This will be perfect for relaxing at home.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm very lucky to receive two wonderful presents like these in one day.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank goodness... Airi and I went to several different stores to pick out a design we thought would suit you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm sure your legs must get chilly when you're sitting in class. We'd love for you to get use out of it!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And we wanted to make sure you wouldn't catch a cold, so we also shopped around for something nice and warm!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We made sure to pick out the fluffiest one we could find, so we hope you like it☆

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's going to be cold for a while longer still, so we hope it keeps you warm when you're working at home.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Wow... You all put so much thought into it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: C'mon everyone, we have a ton of snacks, so dig in!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: KAITO and MEIKO, come a little closer! There's no point in a party if you don't enjoy yourselves♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What kinds of things did you get?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: My classmates gave me an osmanthus-scented hand cream, my club juniors gave me a mug...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And... I was given two blankets.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. It sounds like a lot of people wanted to celebrate your birthday.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Really? Did you do something to celebrate at home too?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Mochizuki made pot-au-feu for dinner, and the three of us ate it together.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Um... Are you sure about this?
My joining you, I mean...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, it's about dinnertime, and... It's nice to have someone over like this sometimes.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Not at all. It's my pleasure to join you two.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um, Asahina. I didn't get a chance to say it at school, but...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh. So you had dinner with Honami.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh... But it's still too early to be content with all that! After all, we still haven't celebrated with you♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: First on our program of events is a cat's cradle demonstration by Miku and Kanade♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So we should play cat's cradle...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I... I don't know how well I can do it...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's fine, Mizuki's just making stuff up.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (This birthday was a bit different from usual...since we celebrated at Kanade's. But...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (This scene hasn't changed at all. Also...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Asahina.
As always, thank you for looking out for Ena... Please feel free to come over again sometime.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Asahina! Did my spell work?
I'd be as happy as a clam if you had a super smiley birthday☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. If Emu cast a spell on you, then I'm confident it must have been a wonderful birthday.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed! No one has smile-power like Emu! But to go beyond today and fill your year with smiles, here is a birthday wish from all of us! Here we go!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Asahina! I'd love it if we could go sightseeing together somewhere, like we did on the school trip!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me too. I enjoyed our tour of the city and getting to chat together. I was so happy to make those memories with you, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I said it at school, but happy birthday!
As your clubmate, know that you can lean on me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was so shocked that we got the same present as the others...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I'm really happy you liked them, Asahina! I hope you get lots of use out of that cozy blanket!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Happy birthday.
I often hear about you from my bandmates and Shizuku. I hope we can continue to get to know each other.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Asahina.
We don't see each other as often now that we're not on the same committee... But I hope we can still chat from time to time.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Even though I couldn't be there to give you your present, I was glad to share a meal with you. If there's ever anything I can do, please let me know.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Mafuyu.
Well, I guess it's not the “happiest” time for you right now...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But only if just for today, I hope you can relax. It is your birthday, you know?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Exactly! We hope you had a blast celebrating with us!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I know you have a lot on your mind lately. But we'll be there when it gets tough. That's what friends are for, Mafuyu!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Happy birthday.
It really does feel strange to say that so many times in one day.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I know that so much has changed...
But one thing will always stay the same. One day, I swear I'll write a song that can save you, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, I'm looking forward to another year with you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: A lot of people gave me wished me a happy birthday today...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It was different from usual in a lot of ways... But I didn't mind.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you all for the birthday wishes.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mafuyu, would you like some more tea?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm glad we decided to hold this tea party today. The sun isn't too bright and there's hardly any wind.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Everyone! Can I have your attention?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I've prepared a little activity for us.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I was wondering what was in that bag you brought. When did you buy these?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I haven't seen these in so long.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know, right? After I heard that we'd be having a tea party in the park, I thought we could all do it together♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
So I got us bubble-blowing sets!
Just gimme one second to hand them out!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I'll give you a hand too!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Blowing bubbles...?
I haven't done that since I was little.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Would you like to blow some bubbles with us, Asahina?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you for asking. I think I will.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yes, perfect!
Here's a straw and bottle of bubble liquid!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Here's your straw and bottle, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you...
This really does take me back.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Hehe. The little ones are flying away...
They're beautiful.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, hey!
Let's have a contest to see who can blow the biggest bubbles!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Alright, you're on!
Haruka, everyone, join us!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Come to think of it, I remember managing to make double bubbles with a lot of effort.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, like blowing one inside another?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, but I'd need one of those big bubble wands. I don't think I can with just a straw.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: There might be one in that set Saki bought. Why don't we go ask her?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Nothing's wrong.
I was just seeing how much fun everyone's having.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I feel like blowing bubbles isn't something high schoolers should be doing...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You need to blow before the liquid all drips out, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay, watch.
First, you make a big bubble using the wand.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Then you blow a bubble inside it.
*Blow*
Oh no...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
It popped.
But you were really close.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I feel like you'll get it on your next try.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (It's such a lively party, but it doesn't feel obnoxious...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I guess this is okay once in a while...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, perfect!
We were just thinking about looking for you guys.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
We have something for all of you.
You brought it, right, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Another girl brought these to our tea party, and she let us take back what was left.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You really surprised us when you asked if you could have them, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If it's okay with you, Tenma, would you mind if I took the rest of these straws and liquid?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I have some friends who might be interested in them.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You and the others have never blown bubbles before, right, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wow... D-Does this mean we get to...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I mean, that's why she brought these over.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Here are some straws and bottles of bubble liquid...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Here, let me show you.
Start by dabbing the straw in the liquid, and...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Dab it in the liquid, and...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I think you have to blow harder.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Mafuyu, why are these bubbles able to float like this?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Because the air we breathe out is warm.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, like a hot-air balloon.
But they can only fly for so long before the surrounding air saps it of its heat.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, let's have a contest to see whose bubbles can survive in the air the longest.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Couldn't you have phrased that in a less scary way, Luka...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, did it sound that scary?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Okay, we'll all go at once.
Can you four be our judges?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Seeing Miku and the others blow bubbles like this starting to make me feel a warmth in my chest...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I think that means you're happy.
Because they're enjoying blowing bubbles so much.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, Kanade, Mafuyu, let's join them!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, now that we've had a chance to see how Ena's doing, let's start from the beginning.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, I'd like to go back for one of the pamphlets they had at the reception desk. I forgot to take one earlier.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Good idea. Those usually list all the paintings and their titles, so I'll grab one too...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then, shall we return to the entrance?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Let's see... The theme of this exhibit is “Deep in the Night”, right?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, and most of these paintings appear to go along with that theme. But...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The night from each one feels so different.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa... This one feels a lot darker than the others we've seen so far.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: This alleyway turns pitch black up ahead, and it feels like the buildings on each side are closing in on the viewer. Like you're about to get crushed...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: This is incredible. I didn't realize a painting could invoke such deep feelings...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I see a bit of Ena in this...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I'm also seeing some similarities.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Ena's art also has this way of bringing a lot of different feelings to the surface.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah. The illustrations she does for N25 in particular since they're like a visual representation of your feelings, Kanade, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It made me realize just how much Ena's art has supported us.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Alright, we're pretty far in now.
The next painting is...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
How do I put it...?
A lot of feelings went into the other paintings we saw...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But there's more to this one.
It feels different for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's titled... “A Peony Blooming in the Night”...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It does feel different from the others for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... But all the technical stuff feels the same. His style hasn't changed, and the colors he used aren't wildly different or anything...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Light is more central to this painting.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: He had light in his other paintings, but it looked like it was emphasizing the night and darkness...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But the light in this one feels special for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I agree. Something else went into this painting. Something much deeper.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I have no idea what Ena's dad was feeling when he drew this painting...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But it's clear that it means a lot to him.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup! I'm glad we got to take our time and see all of them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, is that a gift shop?
I wanna get some postcards of the paintings I really liked.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: In that case, I'd like to take a look too. How about you, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I promised Miku and the others that I'd bring back some souvenirs, so I'll join you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Then, let's take a look!
Let's see... The postcards are all...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
They have quite a wide selection here.
They even have some different paintings to the ones we saw today...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (It's that one... “A Peony Blooming in the Night”...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Do you like that one, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I had to ask since you've been staring at it for quite a while.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I can't stop looking at it for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Then, wanna buy these together?
I was also thinking about getting some postcards of this one!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: In that case, I'd like to also get this one.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Okay!
Then, let's take these up front♪

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I know we talked about having dinner once we returned, but it's still a little early...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Not all that much.
We did just go to that cafe with Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
True, and I'm not very hungry either.
So, let's have dinner a little later, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: In that case, can I go over to SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes. I'd like to take over the souvenirs I bought for everyone.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Right. Then, I'll go with you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh...
Did you just get back from Ena's dad's exhibit?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, we just returned.
And I came to give you these.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Postcards.
There's enough for everyone, so please take any that you like.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Thank you...
I'll let the others know later so we can choose together.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, is this one of his paintings?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. We actually saw it in person earlier today.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But also a little sad for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, the theme was “Deep in the Night”, so many of the paintings there were rather dark...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, this painting is called “A Peony Blooming in the Night.”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. The other paintings were also nice...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But this one seems a little different...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Like some special feelings went into it...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You feel that way too, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
We thought the same thing.
This painting felt different for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: When I saw this painting, I initially felt warmth...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But also a tremendous amount of pain.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: A sort of deep despair and internal struggle...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes...
I also saw pain hidden within this painting.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, this flower... I have to think it means quite a lot to Ena's dad.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: This painting seems to encapsulate a wide range of feelings.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't know what those feelings are exactly...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I'm glad I got to see it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I have to tell him next time...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'll be done with the lyrics soon, so if you don't mind taking a look...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hello. Thank you for having me over again today.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you for coming, Ms. Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, about what we discussed yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I brought over everything for the pot stickers! Making each one by hand should be very enjoyable.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Umm... Not quite...
I asked Ms. Mochizuki about dishes that the three of us could make together.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You weren't feeling well yesterday, so I thought an activity like this would help take your mind off of things.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, would you like to make some with us...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If everything's already been prepared, then I suppose...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Alright, I'll put the filling in a bowl.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you for waiting.
Let's start wrapping these.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay.
Oh, Mafuyu, have you ever made pot stickers before?
