rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes...
I made some with my mom and for home ec.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Right. I helped make some when I was little before, but I don't know about now...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Can I watch you two first?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Asahina, these skins are for the regular pot stickers. And these are for the ones we'll be boiling.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then, I'll start with the regular ones.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You're really good at folding the edges, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Really? I think I'm just okay...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Where should I put the ones that are wrapped?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: There should be a little plate next to you with potato starch on it. Please lightly dip the base of each one in it before placing them on the big plate.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Including the skins for the ones we're going to boil, there should just over thirty in total...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Mochizuki split them evenly into three piles, so we should only have to make about ten each...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I'll try making one now.
Let's see... First, place some of the filling onto the skin and...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I think that's a little too much, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay, the water comes next.
Oh, I think my hands are a little too wet now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's okay, but you'll need to be gentle with the skins. The second they get stuck to your palms, they become easy to rip.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(That's five...
It's nice how I don't have to think about anything else.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Although, I really should be studying instead of making these...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
M-Ms. Mochizuki, what do I do...?
The pot sticker skin is sticking to my fingers and palms now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. Just a second.
Whenever that happens...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I think I'll keep doing this for a little while longer...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Enanan, I just sent you my thoughts on your illustration.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Okay, thanks.
Was there anything that didn't match up with the lyrics?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<No, nothing like that.
But something did catch my attention.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <The landscape the girl sees through the window. The plants seemed fine, but I felt that there were too many flowers blooming.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, yeah. I wasn't sure about that either. A part of me felt that it should be brighter and flowery since the song is reaching its climax...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hmm... But I agree that there are too many blooming. What if I made some of them gray...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hey, don't say things that are gonna make me feel less motivated.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I've finished looking at Ena's illustration, Kanade, so I'll be going back to studying.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay. Thank you for stopping briefly to do that.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
This seems like a good place to stop and have something to eat.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We still have some of those boiled pot stickers left over from the other day...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Right. I might have some of those.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Wait, what? You two made boiled pot stickers?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, we made them with Ms. Mochizuki.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <To be fair, all we did was help wrap them.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Still, I had no idea!
Oh, did you make any UFOs?!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, like the ones you wrap with two skins like a sandwich, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <That sounds more like “stacking” as opposed to “wrapping.”>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <True that! They're pretty easy to make, and they look really cool after you deep fry them!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Also, Enanan, it sounds like you've heard of them! Have you made them before?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I only helped. Akito was the one who actually made them.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Also, I think he made a few ninja stars.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Oh, I think I've made those before too!
But I usually call them pinwheels.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <You said your brother made them, Enanan. What about you?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Wait, did you make him do all the work because you didn't want your hands to get all gross?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<I got my hands dirty too.
Yeah, I really didn't want to, but it was fine once I got used to having a little bit of starch on my fingers.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh... The pot sticker skin's stuck to my hand again...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The starch on your fingers has become balled up.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's natural since you don't make these often. Here, use this washcloth.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: S-So, your hands aren't supposed to get that sticky...? Come to think of it, Mafuyu, you and Ms. Mochizuki had no trouble...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Look what you did, Enanan. You could've chosen your words more carefully.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <What? I wasn't trying to make her feel bad!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Try not to think about it too much, K!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <That's only gonna make her think about it even more.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Anyway, let's head to the kitchen.
We also need to prepare that glass noodle soup...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, are you gonna put the boiled pot stickers in that?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Yes. It's instant soup, but Ms. Mochizuki suggested that we make it using a few vegetables and such...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Also, all this talk of food is making me hungry. I might go grab a quick bite too.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah, same here♪
See you all in a bit!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm glad we were able to get here without getting lost. Thank you for looking up the best route from the station, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But we got here much earlier than I was expecting...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's better than being late and having to rush over. I mean, I'm such a terrible runner.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Anyway, where is the concert being held?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The hall itself is apparently to our left.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But this pamphlet says that the waiting line is straight up ahead from here.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right...
It tells us exactly where to wait.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Then, why don't we take a look at some of the booths on our way over?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: They have so many different instruments here.

rows.Speaker: Clerk A
rows.Line: Here, try plucking this string using your pick.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
Wow! Did you see that?
I got it to make a sound!

rows.Speaker: Boy's Brother
rows.Line: Yeah, I saw. But I know you can do better than that. Try plucking it harder next.

rows.Speaker: Clerk B
rows.Line: Oh, you were in your school's brass band?

rows.Speaker: Woman
rows.Line: Yes. I haven't played at all since high school, but I've been thinking about picking it back up again, since my children are all grown up now.

rows.Speaker: Young Man A
rows.Line: Huh? Why are you able to play that so well?

rows.Speaker: Young Man B
rows.Line: Because I work hard every day?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, are all these different sounds bothering you...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: That means you don't need this synthesizer anymore, right? I'll hold onto it for now.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <My dad brought it back over for me today.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Now you can go back to writing lyrics and mixing songs without having to borrow K's.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (What is this feeling that's stirring within my chest?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'm not sure, but...
I don't think they're bothering me.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh...
They have a piano over there that anyone can play.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Shall we try playing it like we did during Shibuya Festa?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, excuse me.
We'd like to try playing this piano.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What would you like to play?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The same thing we did that time.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Playing an instrument like this really puts me at ease.)

rows.Speaker: Attendees
rows.Line: Such a beautiful song... I wonder what it's called?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Phew...
I wasn't sure I'd be able to play it properly, since it's been so long...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh?! Where did all these people come from?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
That was a surprise...
I didn't think people would start gathering around us.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Thank you...
For inviting me to play.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And the concert will be starting soon, so why don't we go line up for it?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right.
I need to log into Nightcord.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Now that we're all here, why don't we get started?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Unfortunately, we're all waiting on Amia to finish editing the video.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah, yeah, I'm working on it.
The rest of you can talk about when we're gonna have our after-party, since you're so free.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <That's fine, but I kinda want to hear about the convention you two went to, K.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Then, pick some of it and tell us.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <We saw that they had a public piano set up, so K and I decided to play something together.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Yes, we played K's song, like we did during Shibuya Festa... And before we realized it, a lot of people had gathered around us.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Haha! It's hard not to notice two people playing together.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <And the songs K plays are always really pretty.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <What did those people do after you finished playing? Nothing weird, I hope.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Wait, that's it?
I was sort of hoping to hear about them swarming you.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I'm glad that they were all polite.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Anyway, you said a lot happened. Tell us more. Anything fun or interesting?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <They held a quiz contest during the concert. K and I got every question right.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <They had quite a few questions about chords and double notes played on different instruments. The goal was to identify them.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But plenty of other people also got every question right. I have a feeling that they were meant to be easy to answer.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <We received some vouchers for one of the shops in the food court...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But we didn't end up using them.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Wait, why? Were neither of you hungry?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <So, after the concert, we met this boy who really liked to play the trumpet...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <So he couldn't make it sound good, huh...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <They do say all wind instruments, not just trumpets, can be really hard to play unless you know the right tricks.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <We didn't know much about wind instruments either, so we decided to take him over to a booth with a demo area where he could try playing one.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Shiraishi and Aoyagi were working at that booth.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <They knew the manager, and were lending him a hand by helping with the customers.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Really? Toya helping customers?
I would have liked to see that!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Me too! I bet he did a great job of explaining stuff in a really polite manner!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <He did. He even did a tremendous job with the boy we'd brought over.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <The boy was ready to give up on the trumpet, but Aoyagi convinced him to keep trying. We actually ended up all practicing together.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Whenever I go back to school after a while away, he's always there to tell me how far the class has progressed for math and other subjects♪>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <He even tells me about the things the teachers say are gonna be on upcoming tests, which has been super helpful.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Aren't you relying on him a little too much, Amia?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Man, a lot really did happen!
Thanks for telling us, you two! That was really fun♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Actually, Yuki...
Why don't you tell your dad this story the next time you meet him?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Hey, that's a great idea!
I bet he'd feel a lot better knowing that you're having fun with K.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <If you feel comfortable, Yuki, then I also think you should try telling him.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<Okay...
I'll try to tell him the next chance I get...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (That should be all the gloves and hats we're going to need.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I was also able to borrow some cans of bug spray, so that just leaves—)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I brought those garbage bags you asked for!
The custodian gave me a lot, so we should be all set☆

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Thank you, Otori.
Then, let's put these in that box over there.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Humhumhummm♪
Pulling weeds, pulling weeds, it's so much fun♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We'll be getting the snacks and drinks on the day of the weed pulling, right?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, that's right. The teachers were going to get them for us, but the head priest was kind enough to tell the business owners in the local shopping district about what we're doing, and they've decided to give us some assistance.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow, even everyone from the shopping district is on board now?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That means we've really gotta make sure we pull lots of weeds and put on a fun test of courage☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Let's make the most of every minute we have left☆

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, we seem to have everything we need, so let's stop here for today. Thank you for all your hard work, Otori.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You're welcome! We both worked really hard today!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Anyway, shall we start heading out?
We can bundle everything up and—

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We don't have to leave for a few more minutes, so can you tell me what you think about my monster acting?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Your monster acting?
Oh, for the test of courage...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yes! I've been thinking lots and lots about how to play a cute monster!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I told Tsukasa and the others about what we're doing, and they suggested that coming up with a little story would make things easier...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, we came up with a short story called “The Spirits of the Colorful Haunted Mansion”...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: “The Spirits of the Colorful Haunted Mansion”...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's about people stumbling upon a mansion deep within some dark mountains. The resident spirits start by scaring them a little, but they end up becoming friends and partying together later on☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Each room is home to a different spirit, and each of them scares people in its own unique way.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And I play a pink monster that lives in a pink room☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hinomori plays a snow-white yuki-onna who haunts a white room. And Honami...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (She came up with a story to help her get into character...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (The test of courage is supposed to be sort of an added bonus after the weed pulling. More to the point, it's just something we have to do as class representatives...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm gonna jump out and shout, but not in a scary way. My goal is to make it feel like my monster wants to play with everyone!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, but! I have a feeling that doing lots of cute poses and stuff will help make things a lot more fun for everyone! Also...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then, all the rooms in the mansion combine together... And make a rainbow appear in the sky!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I thought your story was lovely.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm sure that everyone will smile when they see you as that monster, Otori.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa, Nene, Rui and I thought really long and hard about this story and my monster!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, but we actually came up with a few different variations!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: During our discussion, we came up with lots and lots of fun ideas!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Would you like to hear them?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I don't mind staying to listen for a bit longer, but...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, I am interested in hearing these other ideas...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But you still haven't shown me how you're going to play your monster.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then, I'll start with the part where I jump out! Watch and tell me what you think...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Okay, she's finally going to show me.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, you passed the test of courage with flying colors. I'll take your flashlights here.

rows.Speaker: Local Elementary Schooler A
rows.Line: That test of courage was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Local Elementary Schooler B
rows.Line: I was worried that it was gonna be really scary, but all the monsters and stuff ended up being really cute...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm glad to hear that.
I'll let the monsters know that you thought they were cute.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I promised the scarers that I'd come get them once we finished, so I should find Hinomori and the others.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (She should be just over there, so I should probably start with her. The area she covered was—)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (That girl... Is she beckoning to me?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(She looks like an elementary schooler.
I don't remember her volunteering today...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (And her yukata... It looks so old...)
The yuki-onna girl lost her way.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I see. Thank you for letting me know. Can you tell me where she is now?

Yeah, my friend said she'd help her...
This way.
I heard a lot of people having fun earlier around the shrine this afternoon. What were you all doing?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We also made shaved ice, which did seem to get everyone excited.
Shaved ice...? I haven't had any in so long.
I had some during a festival at a different shrine a long time ago...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We ran out of shaved ice, but we do still have a few snacks left.
But I didn't help pull weeds or anything...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You told me that my friend was lost.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'll set aside enough for you and your friend.

Thanks...
Then, can you leave them behind the shrine office for us?
You seem a little different when you're not with your friends.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But you don't need to do what I do, right...?

Oh, even though you noticed us here...
Please don't tell the head priest that you did.
He's a really nice man. He keeps the cemetery nice and clean.
So, I don't want to scare him...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I see. Then, I promise not to tell him.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hinomori, there you are. Thank goodness I was able to find you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me too. I got a little lost, but this little girl kindly showed me where to—

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The girl I was just with a second ago is gone. Where could she have gone...? I didn't get a chance to thank her...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, that should be fine. I promised to give her and her friend some snacks later.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, okay!
Then, I'll help you choose what to get.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Anyway, we need to find Otori next.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: She should be just down that way, so we should be able to find her fairly quickly. Let's go.

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Thank you all for your patience!

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: The Kamiyama High Quiz Tournament, brought to you by the Kamiyama High School Festival Planning Committee, will now begin!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Almost all the seats are filled...
Are we all participants?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
It seems that way.
They've placed little flags under our chairs to use when we want to answer.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Under the chairs...?
Oh, you're right. There's a box with flags in it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You can play while seated, so I think a lot of people are partially here to take a break like us.

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Ahem... I will now briefly explain the rules!

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: This quiz is made up of ten multiple-choice questions about Kamiyama High! Each one will have four choices! When answering, please raise the flag with the number that corresponds to your choice.

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Only those who answer correctly will be able to proceed to the next question! We ask those who do not to put their flags back under their chairs and cheer the remaining contestants on!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I suppose you can call these flags, but they're clearly just pieces of construction paper glued to disposable chopsticks...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You're right... Oh, look at mine.
Whoever was cutting totally just eyeballed it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, the triangle on mine looks kinda crooked too.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I actually sort of like how they have a handmade feel to them.

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: I should also mention that each question will become exponentially more difficult as you progress.

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: The tenth question is incredibly hard, so we'll be giving out our snack bag prizes to anyone who answers the ninth question correctly!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, you don't have to get the last question right to win stuff? That's really nice of them.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Or maybe the tenth question is just impossible to get right...

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Now then, let's get this quiz tournament started!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm not sure I'm going to be able to help much, so I'll mostly be relying on you two, Ena, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You can count on us! We're students at this school, so we should be able to answer anything they...

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Our first question will basically be a warm-up problem! “How many years have passed since Kamiyama High School was founded?”

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Please choose from the four choices that are going to appear on the screen!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
H-How many years has it been?
I vaguely remember it being mentioned during the opening ceremony.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I also remember hearing it at some point... Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? You know the answer, Mafuyu?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I helped put together an exhibit about the history of each school in Shibuya as part of my class rep duties, so I'm fairly certain.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Then, three it is!
Hurry, Kanade, raise your flag!

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line:
Next question!
“Which event from Kamiyama High's sports festival always garners considerable acclaim?”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, I know this one!
The cheering competition! So, #1!

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: “What did Class 3-D prepare for this year's festival?” This is meant to be a freebie, so please feel free to take a look at your pamphlets!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That means the answer's grilled squid, so #2.

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: And here's another freebie for you Kamiyama High students out there! “Which teacher is in charge of all the third-years?”

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
U-Uhh...
Do night school and daytime students have the same teacher assigned...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, don't look at me!
I'm not even a third-year!

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line:
Alright, here comes the ninth question!
This one involves the school song!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What?! I don't remember the school song!

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Thank you all for participating in the Kamiyama High Quiz Tournament!

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: We hope that you were all able to learn a few fun facts about our school! And please do keep enjoying our wonderful festival!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha.
We had to start guessing around the sixth or seventh problem.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm really glad we decided to all give different answers for the ninth question so we could win a goodie bag.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But we all would've been able to win goodie bags if you and Mizuki remembered the school song...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: S-Still, that final question was so hard!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I mean, who knows off the top of their head how many windows there are in this school?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The questions were difficult, but it felt pretty enjoyable even though I'm not a student here.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The quiz seemed to be aimed at helping everyone learn a few facts about this school, so I believe they succeeded in that sense.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
That's your takeaway...?
Did you find it fun...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It was a nice break, I think...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I also feel rather refreshed now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That's great to hear!
Anyway, what should we check out next?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We've gone around most of the school now...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, what do we have left? The stalls outside?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. We saw that cotton candy stall at the end and the ones near the rest area...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But we still haven't been to your class's stall, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The lunch rush is probably over, so it may not be all that crowded.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, since we're here!
You practiced making them a ton, right? You gotta grill us up some squid!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, fine. If it isn't that crowded...

rows.Speaker: Ena's Classmate
rows.Line: Hi, Shinonome! Oh, you brought friends...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, they wanted to try our squid.
Oh, these look just about ready, so could we have them...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Wait, Ena, aren't you going to grill us some?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? It doesn't matter who makes them. They basically all turn out the same...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, but we wanna have ones that you grilled.

rows.Speaker: Ena's Classmate
rows.Line:
Hehe. The grill's all yours, Shinonome.
These ones are actually part of an order, and I was just about to go deliver them.

rows.Speaker: Ena's Classmate
rows.Line: So, show your friends just how much you've been practicing for this!

rows.Speaker: Ena's Classmate
rows.Line:
Anyway, I'm gonna go deliver these!
Have fun, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, Ena, show us what you got!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay, fine. I just need to make two, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I mean, all I'll really be doing is throwing them on the grill since they're already seasoned...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, they're starting to sizzle nicely.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha... Alright, then...
What gave you trouble when you were learning how to grill squid?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: How the smell clings to your clothes.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I wore my uniform while practicing on the grill, and it kept smelling no matter how much deodorizing spray I used on it afterwards.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
No way, she's surely got more to say.
Like the trick to grilling them just enough for optimum flavor, or...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Seriously, all I have to do is throw them on the grill! Can't you show a little more interest in what I had to say?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I dunno what to tell you...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then, where were the squids you're grilling caught? Also, what species are they?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? So, we made sure to find two suppliers in case anything happened with one of them...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Which one are these from...?
I remember one of the suppliers was in Hokkaido...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You could've picked an easier topic, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Umm... What should we talk about now...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Come to think of it, squid is apparently “grilled” very differently depending on if you're in the Kanto or Kansai region.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, one of my classmates mentioned that.
We're all used to seeing squid grilled whole as it is over here in Kanto.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, that came up in one of the anime I saw! In Kansai...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The topics you came up with made the time fly right by, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Oh, I don't wanna burn my tongue, so you two start without me.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Here you are, Kanade, Mafuyu.
They're really hot, so please be careful.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's softer and easier to bite through than I expected...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Right? We did get some good squid for this.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But you couldn't remember where these were caught or what species they are...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I mentioned this on Nightcord, but there's this one place where I think Mizuki will show up.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
So, I'm gonna go there!
Would you two mind sticking around here?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I hope we find Mizuki soon.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wait, what if Mizuki comes here instead...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
We can let Ena know.
But I have a feeling that...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: ...we shouldn't let Mizuki see that we're here.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Us being here would be an indicator that Ena is too, which could cause problems if Mizuki wants to avoid her.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: All the paths leading here are so open that there's nowhere to hide. We'll need to sneak on campus and hide in the bushes by the gate.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We should be able to remain hidden from anyone going in or out of the school here.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Having to squat like this is going to be hard for me, but I'll deal with the pain somehow.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: In the event that Mizuki does discover us, we may want to say, “We came looking for Ena.”

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Remember what I just said?
Us being here is a sign that Ena is also present.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: By saying that we're looking for Ena, we can claim that our business is with her alone.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: There's no way for Mizuki to know what we've been up to without logging in to Nightcord, which hasn't happened recently.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We could say that Ena's also stopped logging in and we haven't seen her for a little while...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Do you think Mizuki will want us to elaborate on that further...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
We'd have to lie...
But as long as it keeps Mizuki from running.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wait, what if Mizuki runs without hearing what we have to say?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We'll just have to find a way to win this game of cat and mouse no matter what.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: When we played tag in SEKAI before, I don't think any of us was able to lay a finger on Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I guess someone can have the stamina of a student-athlete without actually playing for any clubs or teams.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
But I'm sorry.
I don't think I'll be of much help if it comes to a footrace...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We should be fine as long as we know which streets Mizuki goes down.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I basically memorized all of the streets, back alleys and side alleys around Kamiyama High the last time I came here to search.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes. I know which streets go where, including where all the best shortcuts are.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Mizuki may miss or cut class a lot, but being a Kamiyama High student still gives the advantage here, so I felt that I needed to understand the lay of the land.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
W-Wow...
I didn't realize just how much effort you were putting into our search...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thanks for doing this, you two...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: All that's left is to see if Mizuki actually appears...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: We'll be waiting right here for you, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wait, where's Kanade?
I thought you two came here together.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: She went to that shop over there to retrieve a CD she ordered.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Still, I'm glad I made it here in time.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I woke up just an hour before I had to leave my house. You should've seen the panic I was in while I got ready.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thanks to that, I was only able to have a slice of bread before coming here.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I feel that you could've skipped that to give yourself more time, since we're having our after-party at the diner.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I know, but I've been craving pancakes today. I didn't want dessert to be the first thing I ate on an empty stomach.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But at the same time, I'm not sure I'd be able to handle pancakes if I had a full meal at the diner.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I can't comment since I've never found myself in that sort of situation.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. Let's ask Kanade and Ena about this when they get here!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: By the way, I think Ena's gonna agree with me, while Kanade says more or less the same thing as you!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I just remembered something I said to you before.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Remember when I talked to you about how scary it is to think you won't be accepted?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You're afraid that he won't understand...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Especially since he's someone really important to you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The thought of possibly being rejected after telling him everything is just so terrifying...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Which makes you think, why bother telling him at all?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That's probably why I became stuck for so long too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I'm starting to think that...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: There are more people who will accept me for who I am than I realized.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Now that I think about it, I really put myself on a pedestal there. I mean, the things I said and the way I talked.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
To be honest...
That was sorta also meant for me.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Because I care so much about myself, I'm really scared of being hurt or rejected...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then, why did you tell me all that?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If you don't like being hurt, then it must've been hard for you to talk about those things.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And yet, you did. Why is that?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
...
It's because of something Luka said a little while back...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: She said that I could help you because I was a coward who'd been running from everything.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And I agreed with her then.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I couldn't just leave you be, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Does this mean you're done running?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Especially since certain people came chasing after me like there was no tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha...
Well, that was sort of a first for me...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The thing is, I asked Ena to wait until I was ready to talk.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But she ended up finding out before I got to, and then I ran away...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I mean, who wouldn't come chasing after me in that situation?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: She didn't stop complaining for a while after that day. She blames you for making her eyes hurt after crying so much, her losing her voice and being sore from running around...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: When I saw her chasing after me, I really didn't want her to...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I actually hoped that she'd give up.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But looking back, I feel really happy knowing that I have a friend who's willing to do that for me...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: At the very least, I'm not running again from Ena or N25... I don't want to...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Just, well...
Go easy on me, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Ena as well.
She seems sleepy...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, we gotta ask them about having dessert on an empty stomach!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <K. Could you check the lyrics for the chorus? I tweaked it a bit.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh. In that case, would you also look over my rough sketch? I feel like I did really well with this one.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Okay. I'll have a look at them.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hey, everyone! Phew, so glad I made it!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Made it? Only by a matter of seconds.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I was on a roll while working offline, and completely lost track of time.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <No, that wasn't the point... I mean, the date's about to roll over! We've got to give you our well-wishes, Yuki!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I can't with you... You were so excited about wishing her a happy birthday right on the dot, and then you never showed. I was wondering what happened.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Sorry, my bad. But I made it on time, so we're good!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I'm so excited for the party in SEKAI tomorrow. Will you be able to make it, Yuki?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I've got club activities, but I should be able to make it back at night.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Really? Great! We better get everything prepared by then!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, speaking of parties... Yuki, didn't Ms. Mochizuki also invite you to another one?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Yes. She asked if I was free during lunch...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You're going to have a party at school too, huh. What's the plan?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hehe. I'm sure there's a bunch of things planned for you behind the scenes.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Wow, what happened to the time?! It's almost midnight! Okay, everyone ready?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Ready? Were you planning on counting down?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Of course! C'mon, here we go! 3, 2, 1. Happy birthday, Mafuyu!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Okay. I'm going to go back to work now.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hahaha. Well, I guess that's our Yuki for you.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Have fun at the party at school!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Alright, does everyone have a party popper?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I really didn't expect such a big celebration.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. We have a lot planned for you, so I hope you have a great time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We also prepared a bunch of food. I say “we,” but all we did is help Honami...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I've packed pot-au-feu in this soup jar. Please have some, if you'd like.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you. I'll have some later to keep myself warm.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe♪ Okey dokey, us next! Please accept this gift!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you. Is this from all of you? May I open it now?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Wow... This scarf looks so warm and cozy.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. We picked it out together.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We went with a simple design that can match our school uniform. I hope you like it...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, we can also guarantee it'll keep you warm! It's earned our seal of approval!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: These two spent time trying on all of the scarves in the store.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, it was for a gift! We wanted to make sure that she could wear it all throughout the winter♪

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you, everyone. It's only going to get colder, so I'll be sure to make good use of this.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I was a little surprised when they said we're celebrating on the rooftop... But it was more normal than I thought.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Why are there instruments and speakers over there?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe, are you curious about those?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, who wouldn't be, when there's a bunch of instruments placed in plain sight.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Since Asahina has already noticed, let's move on to our special segment!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Alright! Girls, if you would do the honors♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Your special seat is over here, Asahina!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Here we go... We would like to wish you a happy birthday with a song, Asahina! Please listen!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (So those instruments were Hoshino's and the others... I had a feeling.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shall we start getting ready too, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I really didn't expect a performance from you all. Thank you. It was wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We wanted to make sure our feelings came across in our performance. I'm glad you enjoyed it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thank you, everyone☆ Next up, we have...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hinomori and Airi! Take it away!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We also wanted to sing and express our feelings for you today.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Feel free to join in the fun too, everyone! Let's have a great time!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We wanted to make sure our feelings came across in our performance. I'm glad you enjoyed it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We also wanted to sing and express our feelings for you today.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Um... So Asahina, how did you find it?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It was great. I really enjoyed it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I was a little surprised by the sudden show... But it made me happy to hear you all sing.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The truth is... I asked Mizuki for help.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. I wanted to throw a party for your birthday, but I wasn't exactly sure about what to do...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's when Mizuki suggested singing, since music is so important to you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I see. So Mizuki was the one...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hehe. I'm sure there's a bunch of things planned for you behind the scenes.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you for putting in so much thought just for me. It means a lot.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But, the special segment is far from over! Next up will be our turn!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's right☆ I actually prepared a video with some special someones! Firstly, a message for you!

rows.Speaker: Rui's Voice
rows.Line: <Happy birthday, Asahina. We heard about the party from Emu. It's not much, but we would also like to be a part of the celebration.>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: <It is your birthday, after all! We have put our all into it, so we hope you enjoy!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: They helped me come up with a way to wish you a happy birthday☆ So we made you an original birthday song! Please listen!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: An original birthday song? Hehe, I wonder what it sounds like.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe♪ Then without further ado, I'll press play.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, once again... Happy birthday, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I know this will be your second party, Mafuyu, but let's all have a fun time too♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mafuyu had a party at school too. How did it go?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I received an original birthday song.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And... Some of my juniors performed a song for me, while two girls from my year who are also working as idols sang and danced.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What?! Wait, so Saki and gang, and Shizuku and Airi performed live just for you?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I thought you knew? Hinomori said that she asked for your help.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, she did. But I didn't know that that's what they came up with in the end!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Based on Mizuki's reaction, they must be pretty amazing.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Of course! We're talking about an up-and-coming band and idols that are already famous!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And they performed for you live for free! I'm so jealous....

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Well, that's because it's a special birthday gift, no?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But, an original birthday song... That sounds like a lovely present.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I think it was a nice song.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay, then we should sing too!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Well, I don't want to be left behind when it comes to celebrating Mafuyu's birthday! It'd be nice to sing with those feelings in mind, right?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh... I-In that case, I'd like to sing too...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, that's more like it! Since it's an occasion, MEIKO, KAITO, would you like to join too?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Birthday or not, they're the same as usual...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hahaha. If you ever feel like it, then join in whenever! Alright, I hope you enjoy this, Mafuyu!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Asahina. We heard from Akito it was your birthday, so we wanted to give you our well-wishes.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Seriously, you could have told us sooner, Akito. We could've prepared a gift!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well this is how we're doing it, so stop complaining.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Um... Sorry about that, Asahina. Please let us celebrate with you another time. Happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Here we go, everyone! Ready, go! Happy birthday, Asahina☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe♪ We worked really hard on the celebrations, so I hope you had a fun time at today's party!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We heard from Emu that you enjoyed our original birthday song! I'm glad to hear it as the lyricist!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. We did struggle quite a bit on finding a way to express our feelings.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We decided to go with a video, but... I hope our feelings reached you, even just a little bit. Happy birthday, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Asahina! I'm so glad that you enjoyed the party today. Let's invite Mizuki and Ena, and all go out somewhere together sometime soon.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's have lunch together again sometime when our schedules match up, Asahina. Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Asahina! Thank you so much for spending time with us today!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm glad you enjoyed our performance. It made all of the practicing worth it!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You all were really pulling out all the stops. I think you can pat yourselves on the back, considering the results.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. We put a lot of heart and soul into it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. I hope our feelings reach you. Happy birthday, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Mafuyu! How did you like our song?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We made sure to give it our all to measure up to everyone at Miya Girls, so I hope you liked it!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It was a rowdier party than I expected...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But, looks like you enjoyed yourself. Happy birthday, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It also makes me happy to celebrate your birthday like this with everyone, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Once again, happy birthday. Also... I'm going to keep composing. So that I can save you one day.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thanks to everyone at school and in SEKAI, I got to listen to a lot of songs.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: All songs full of feelings, huh...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't exactly know what feelings were in there, but...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: They were all good songs, I think.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you for wishing me a happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Just one week left until Valentine's Day.
We're in the final stretch.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Come to think of it, Mizuki's apparently going over to the sewing lounge again today.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that means we'll get to work as a group again.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: How are your gifts coming along?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'm just about done with the embroidery on mine.
I just have to shape them into pouches now.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
You work fast, Kiritani.
I still have quite a lot left to do.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You also have to make your home ec project, after all.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, but I'm already finished with that.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
And I have you to thank, Hinomori.
I really appreciate the help you've given me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
No, don't thank me...
You were the one who put in the work, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Does that mean you can focus on your gifts for Valentine's Day now?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, it does.
But only when I take breaks from studying.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You've been working in the library, yes?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, because it's so quiet. Embroidering has been a nice way for me to take my mind off of things.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I'm running out of time, so I'll need to pick up the pace now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, let's do our best together!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (If I can keep this up, I should have everything ready by Valentine's Day.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Next, I think I'll work on Miku's handkerchief...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Uh oh... I forgot how to do this part...
Sorry, Shizuku, but would you mind showing me again?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's see... So that's where you are? I see. So now, you need to use a different stitch...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I think I'll go with a finer gradation here.
Yeah, that should make it look a lot better!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I was wondering where our gifts were going.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Mine are going to the other members of my group and our manager. Them, and some senior idols who have been helping us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, this is a golden opportunity for us to show our appreciation for them.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We're able to lead fulfilling lives as idols because of their help and support.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I see. I can tell that they mean quite a lot to the both of you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
The others in my group...
And a few other friends who mean a lot to me.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: They've been a huge source of support, and I really can't thank them enough for that.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes... I'm sure they're going to love your gifts.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Showing appreciation for those who mean the most to you...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Embroidery, huh... Yes, a gift does tend to feel more special when you know it's handmade.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right? This is just how I feel, but I believe quite a lot of emotion goes into every stitch.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. The process of choosing the right design for the person you have in mind, and carefully stitching it in, really allows you to channel in your emotions.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Which is why, for those truly special occasions, I almost always give people things that I embroidered myself.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Everyone's putting their feelings for the recipients into their gifts...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I should try thanking her through each stitch...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: After Mafuyu went to the trouble of bringing her gifts for them over too.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's not like we asked them to meet with us.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But they should know about our Valentine's Day party. They could hang around nearby for today, at least...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I was wondering why you were all shouting. What are you up to?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
We were looking for you, MEIKO.
Mafuyu has something for you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You're always watching over us, so I decided to make you a gift for Valentine's Day.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh...
Yours has a butterfly embroidered on it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I see...
Thank you for making this.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The rest of us also prepared gifts, so you should come party with us if you're in the mood!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Anyway, if you're also looking for KAITO, he was just over there a second ago.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Then, he might also appear if we keep shouting his name! Hey, KAITO! We have yummy chocolates!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Please come talk to us. Even just for a minute.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Doesn't seem like he wants to.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't have to give this to him.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
No, it's too soon to give up.
I mean, you made this just for him, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I agree. You should give it to him if you can.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Honestly, what kind of person doesn't show up after having their name called this much? If he really is just nearby, then there's no way he doesn't know we're here.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: If he wants to force our hands, we'll just have to give him what he's asking for.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Th-This has gotten intense all of a sudden.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. But I also want you to give this to KAITO personally. I'm very interested in seeing how he reacts.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That's assuming he's going to accept my gift.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I actually believe that he won't be able to refuse.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: After all, he talks about how important it is to be honest about your feelings on a daily basis.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: If you tell him you want him to have it, he won't be able to refuse your gift.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If I tell him that I want him to have it...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (This handkerchief will likely just go to waste if I don't give it to him...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But I'm not sure that equates to me genuinely wanting him to have it...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Aha, you finally decided to show yourself.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Who wouldn't, with you all making such a racket? Anyway, what do you all want?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I have something for you, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I embroidered handkerchiefs for everyone as gifts for Valentine's Day. I was just handing them out.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Embroidered...? You mean this blue flower?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
It's a bellflower.
I thought it suited you, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
But that was so anticlimactic.
I wanted to see him smile, but he only gave us his usual, stone-faced expression.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I mean, anything else would've been pretty startling.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
No, don't go!
We brought chocolates, so you should stay and have some with us!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm glad you managed to hand out all of your Valentine's Day gifts.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I haven't given Mochizuki her gift yet.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I thought about giving it to her at school, but I sort of want to do it at your house, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Then, let's both give our gifts to her when she visits next. I'm sure she's going to be very happy.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
You've stopped eating.
Are you done?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, sorry. No, I was just thinking. I'll eat.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh... No, I'll pass.
I'd like to get right back to work.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
That reminds me...
There's something I'd like to ask you regarding N25, if that's alright.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You know, that message from K took us both by surprise. What's all this “I want to work alone for a while” stuff?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
